Hardening round 2: checksums of the alarm stack's own function bodies. fn_ca_guard_defs_watch notices any change once, files a dashboard incident, and re-baselines.
Private per-user Club Arena hand facts. hole_cards are protected by owner-only RLS; writes are service-role only.
A player's flag on a hand they played, filed with their club's operators. Written only through fn_ca_flag_hand; resolved only through fn_ca_resolve_hand_flag.
A player's own private note and tags on one hand. RLS: readable and writable by that player alone - never by a club, an operator or anon.

Precomputed per-(player,hand) statistics. Exists because reading 750 raw hand_history rows costs ~3,730 random page reads (~15s cold) against an 8s statement_timeout, so the Stats page was being CANCELLED on heavy accounts rather than merely being slow. Retention is the most recent 1,000 hands per player, which is ~585k rows, not 14.2m.
Head-to-head chip flow per hand. Hand-level proportional attribution. Written only when at least one side is human.

When fn_ca_horse_claim_due may next press a horse reward it could not pay. A reward refused by DR7:user_over_daily_cap waits for the America/Chicago day its cap resets; one that failed for any other reason waits ten minutes. The sweep's candidate window skips a deferred reward, so a refused reward never blocks the rewards behind it. A deferral is forgotten once its reward is claimed, expired or past its seven days. Migration 20260930233000.
One row per engine cycle. degraded true means the policy read failed and the engine fell back to its hardcoded defaults.
Fleet steering. One global row carries today behaviour; club and union rows override field by field where not null. Empty table means today behaviour.
GLI-19 disclosure. Every is_horse profile appears here. Never deleted: a vanished horse is stamped retired_at.
One row per horse, upserted by the engine once per seeding cycle. Console read model only; nothing reads it back into a hand.

Every time fn_ca_raise_drift_incident could not file an incident. The function still swallows the error - it is called from settlement paths and must never roll one back - but the evidence now lands somewhere a person can read instead of only in the Postgres log. Added 2026-09-02 after 901 consecutive silent failures caused by one bad layer value.

What was actually delivered, keyed on the FINDING rather than on the incident row. fn_ca_incident_notify sends only when this table has no row for the (recipient, finding) or its state_hash has changed. Replaces the 5-minute digest window, which let every double through because it only collapsed from the third push onward.
Immutable case evidence and case-history events. A correction is a new retraction row; UPDATE and DELETE are rejected.
Stable Admin Phase 5 cases. A detector never opens or decides one. subject_ids includes horses and humans under the same rules.
Append-only sanction decision ledger. Confiscation is recorded as approved but never applied here; this migration contains no chip movement.
Which correction leg restates which original journal leg. No foreign key to chip_ledger on purpose (a scan table never locks a hot relation, CLAUDE.md production DDL rule 7).

Owner-authorized journal-only restatements of a must_be_zero account (fn_ca_restate_must_be_zero_account). One row per operation id; a replay returns this row and posts nothing. No chip moves: fingerprint_before = fingerprint_after is the balance-table proof taken inside the posting transaction.

Chip standard: the threshold at which each meter ESCALATES with its own second opinion (was it explained by a register correction or a definition change; did the previous reading agree in sign). It never opens the payout freeze - a person does that, after reading the page (ruling 2026-09-05, tests/law/PayoutFreezeIsHumanOnly.law.test.ts).
Immutable launch preimages retained online for seven years; owner-directed waiver is not payment, certification or deletion of original journal/hand history.
Immutable seven-year scoped closing testimony. NULL and subcent legacy values are retained exactly, never rounded into an opening or silently rewritten. Derived aliases are explicitly outside supply.

Every time a day's ledger manifest had to change, with the value it held before and why. A sanctioned change to history leaves the attestation corrected rather than silently wrong; the journal rows themselves are in ca_ledger_mutation_log.

Every transaction in which a covered balance and the chip_ledger disagreed at commit while ca_ledger_invariant_mode was observe. Empty is the proof the flip to refuse reads. In refuse mode nothing is written here because the transaction does not commit.

One row. observe: a balance/ledger disagreement at commit is recorded in ca_ledger_invariant_findings and warned. refuse: it aborts the transaction (REFUSED: balance_moved_without_its_ledger_row). Changed only by a migration.

One row: how far fn_ca_ledger_invariant_refusal_watch has checked the refusal counter against its records. A number is only judged unrecorded once a whole watch interval has passed since it was counted. 20261002135708.

Every ledger-invariant refusal (REFUSED: balance_moved_without_its_ledger_row / balance_moved_against_settlement_suspense, SQLSTATE 23514), written by the refusing session on its own loopback connection so the row survives the refused transaction's rollback. kind = unrecorded: the counter shows a refusal whose record never arrived (fn_ca_ledger_invariant_refusal_watch). No foreign keys, by rule (CLAUDE.md section 2 rule 7). 20261002135708.

One row per chip store covered by the ledger invariant (the account-key prefix fn_ca_ledger_tally_key and the tally functions build). observe: a disagreement at commit is recorded in ca_ledger_invariant_findings and warned; refuse: the transaction is aborted (REFUSED: balance_moved_without_its_ledger_row). A store with no row falls back to ca_ledger_invariant_mode. Changed only by a migration.

Severity per app.ledger_maintenance reason PREFIX (split_part(reason, ':', 1)). A kind registered here is filed at that severity by fn_ca_journal_append_only; an unregistered prefix is a warning. The kind must be the exact prefix the writer sets, character for character.

Ledger replay (20261004135607): for each reading snapshot, the chip_ledger legs with xid >= the snapshot xmin that the reading could actually see. A subtransaction xid of a running transaction reads as visible to pg_visible_in_snapshot; this list is the reading's own answer.

Ledger writes the club_members trigger had to swallow. The trigger must never refuse a money write, so failures land here instead of raising. Non-empty means the audit trail is losing rows: investigate immediately.

R6 four-eyes register for any manual money movement. One actor proposes, a DIFFERENT approver approves (CHECK approver <> actor). amount > 0 credits the target, < 0 debits it. fn_settle_tournament_obligation.p_adjustment_id is meant to require an approved row here (Lane A3 follow-up). No row here moves money by itself.
THE MINT: append-only record of every authorized issuance and retirement of chips and diamonds. Written only by fn_ca_mint and fn_ca_burn.

R3 enforcement mode for tournament-category wallet credits. mode=log records a violation and lets the write through; mode=refuse aborts it. One row. Flip back with: UPDATE public.ca_money_path_enforcement SET mode = 'log';

R3 log-only (Lane A3, 2026-09-02): tournament-category wallet credits that did not come through fn_settle_tournament_obligation. Written by trg_ca_money_path_log on wallet_transactions. Never refuses. db_role is the login role (session_user): authenticator = PostgREST, postgres = psql/migration.
Private admission ABI. Preparation leaves legacy behavior; unlimited activation is not yet prepared.

Per (must_be_zero account, UTC hour) journal flow. The maintained running balance behind fn_ca_suspense_regression_check's balance arm; hours older than its refresh window are sealed history. Observation only - no chip moves from here.

One row per must_be_zero account: the audited balance at the moment this control was installed, and the last balance it read. baseline_balance is what "already known, already the owner's decision" means; movement away from it is a NEW finding. An owner who resolves a standing imbalance re-baselines here.

Zero-drift phase 3: durable idempotency claims for admin money movers. A row with result IS NOT NULL is a finalized operation; replaying the same op_id returns the stored result instead of moving money twice. Failure paths delete their claim so a corrected retry re-executes.
Maker-checker queue. A row is written even when approvals are off (status auto_approved) so the trail is complete.
Bounded explicit-request export owner; immutable source capture, lease-fenced recovery and authenticated private artifact retrieval. No schedule.
Named role grants. Never deleted: a revoke stamps revoked_at and keeps the history.
Append-only operator ownership overlay. Acknowledge/release never resolves or mutates its source incident.
Operator-authored notes about a player. Soft delete only: a deleted note keeps its author and its text. This is NOT public.player_notes, which is a player-facing feature about opponents.
Single row. Safe defaults: approvals off, enforcement off, alone rule on, thresholds 0, TTL 1440 minutes.
The permission vocabulary, mirrored from src/lib/horses/permissions.js plus admin.manage.
Named operator roles plus the three legacy profile roles. Additive: a role here never removes access.

Kill switch consulted by fn_settle_tournament_obligation: an open row (cleared_at IS NULL) with scope tournament_payouts refuses every settle with payout_frozen. Written ONLY by fn_ca_open_payout_freeze / fn_ca_clear_payout_freeze, which a human calls. Nothing opens it automatically (Lane E, 2026-09-02; tests/law/PayoutFreezeIsHumanOnly.law.test.ts).
Every recovery reload fn_ca_pgrst_reload_if_stale has sent. Doubles as the cooldown: the newest row is the last time one went out.
Operator restrictions on a player account. One active row per scope per player. Horses and humans alike. Nothing here refuses anything until ca_operator_policy.restrictions_enforced is true.

Append-only testimony for every deleted profiles row: identity, diamond holdings, db role and application that removed it. Written by trg_ca_profile_deletion_journal (never blocks). Exists because the 2026-09-02 1,259,900-diamond deletion mystery had no witness (issue #2613).

One row. Every rake/BBJ rule constant the engine compiles in (server/src/config/rakeSpec.ts). Part of fn_rake_spec_checksum(); change it and the engine raises RakeSpec.drift at its next check and keeps dealing on its compiled-in spec until it is redeployed to match.
Mirror of RAKE_SCHEDULE in src/config/RakeConfig.ts. rake_cap is an absolute amount. Read only by the rake-law alarm; the engine uses its own copy.
Rake cap by big blind and players dealt: the engine's playerCountCaps materialised for every stake it deals. Rebuilt by fn_rake_spec_rebuild_caps(); part of fn_rake_spec_checksum().
Mirror of STAKES_TIERS in src/config/RakeConfig.ts. Covers stakes the schedule does not name. max_bb NULL is the open top end.
High-water marks for the structural money-path ratchets. baseline only ever moves down (fn_ca_ratchet_watch tightens it); growth past it raises a drift incident.
What the restriction guards WOULD have refused while enforcement is off. Retained by age. Nothing reads this on a hot path.

Cron jobs deliberately withdrawn. v_openclaw_job_staleness excludes them, so a job that was correctly removed stops reporting is_stale forever. A row here needs a REASON: retiring a job to silence its alarm, rather than because the work moved or ended, is the failure this table must not become. Broken jobs do not belong here - they belong fixed.

CHIP STANDARD C2 dry run (2026-09-02): every table_seats INSERT / resurrection with stack > 0 that fn_ca_guard_seat_creation WOULD refuse once enforced. Empty for 24h = safe to enforce. Rows here name a seat creator that is not on the sanctioned list; add it there or fix it before flipping the guard to RAISE.

One row per seat whose stack, at the moment of a hand write, differed from the stack the engine dealt from. amount > 0 is a credit that landed on the row the engine never saw (a resolved add-on, a horse funding) and was PRESERVED instead of erased; amount < 0 is a debit likewise. Written by fn_ca_settle_hand_stacks_absolute in delta mode (chip standard 2026-09-04).
Chip standard Phase 6.1: the platform sources that may settle a tournament obligation under their own name. engine.* is implicit. Any other source must name an approved ca_manual_adjustments row.
Percentile breakpoints per metric per cohort. cohort=field includes horses (584 of 585 users with hands). Refreshed by ca_refresh_stat_distribution().

One row per run of ca_stats_witness_audit(): the engine's recorded button and showdown roster checked against the action log, and the two coverage gaps (hands with no stat row, human hands with no settlement row). Zero in every disagree/without column is the healthy state.
One row per tournament fee captured after its producing transaction ended. Append only. The population it exists for is closed: ca_fee_cutover_is_drained stops another from being created.

A conservation breach stops being reported only when a person writes down why. The reason has a minimum length on purpose: "ok" is not an explanation, and this row is the audit trail for chips that could not be accounted for.
Immutable full-row testimony moved from audit_trail only when the guarded test-account sweeper deletes the synthetic actor. Never contains real-player rows.
Private immutable whole-row identity and financial-testimony snapshot for an exact Auth-less certification identity retired by a byte-pinned forward migration. Never contains a real-player row.
Immutable whole-row testimony for a chip_ledger actor detached only by the exact reserved certification-account cleanup door.

Successive readings of tournament chip conservation. Two readings with the same drift, separated by completed hands, is the signature of chips that are actually gone rather than sitting in a pot the database cannot see.

Opening club_treasury balances at the 2026-08-31 cutover. Everything before taken_at is acknowledged as unreconstructable; reconcile_ledger_nightly measures chip_ledger flow forward from this line. Mirrors ca_chip_baseline for the player-wallet pool. Do NOT re-baseline: moving the line erases real drift.
Every session fn_ca_writer_lock_sentinel cancelled for holding the live tables behind a writer-blocking lock (incident 2026-10-22 02:34 UTC).
Append-only reservation identities for caption provider spend. Reserved rows remain worst-case committed until an explicit bounded settlement.
Fleet Phase 2 caption model gate and UTC daily micro-USD cap. The seeded row is disabled, unconfigured and zero-budget.
Daily per-user rollup of Card Slide corner-peel usage. Written only by fn_record_card_slide_usage; read in aggregate by fn_card_slide_adoption.

One row per attempted Cluster mode conversion, carrying the nine things the specification requires a conversion to record. The partial unique index on (cluster_id) WHERE status = pending is F13's answer - two simultaneous converters cannot both open one - and the unique conversion_request_id makes a retry of the same request idempotent and answerable with what already happened rather than merely refused.

Append-only history of a Cluster's seating regimes: one row per (cluster, epoch), the mode it ran under, when it started and when it ended. cash_games.cluster_epoch is the pointer to the current one; this is what it points at. Rows are never deleted and never renumbered, which is what makes them safe to reference from Lightning history.

One row per Lightning matcher pass that ran (fn_lightning_match_and_form), keyed by the caller's request id: what the pass saw and what it formed. A retried request id is answered from here and forms nothing. Append only: service_role may read and insert, never update or delete.
One open row per player per must-move game: joined_at is the must-move order (Dan 2026-09-05). Closed when the last chair in the game empties; a rejoin is a new row at the bottom.
Operation Table Stakes: a cash GAME (the cluster). ruleset_snapshot is the resolved template + host overrides at creation; live games never mutate when the template changes.
Chip continuity (OPORD 1.3 s6). One open row per player per scope. stay_remaining_ms is as of stay_last_tick_at; derive with fn_cash_stay_remaining_ms.
Chip continuity rejoin floor. Key = player + club + variant + sb + bb. Table id and template name are deliberately absent (invariant I8).
A player's one voluntary table change inside a must-move game (never from or to Main 1). to_table_id NULL = any table but Main 1. requested -> moved (a cash_seat_moves row) | cancelled.
Server-owned Cashier roster/batch SLO events. Contains no amounts, recipients, notes, or free-form error messages; browsers write only through fn_record_cashier_operation.

Player cashout queue. Client writes are barred by three RESTRICTIVE policies; the only write paths are fn_cashout_request / fn_cashout_approve / fn_cashout_release (SECURITY DEFINER) and service_role. Reads are scoped by cashout_read_scoped.

One row per keyed chip_ledger leg. Holds the journal's idempotency guarantee OUTSIDE the journal, so it survives partitioning: a partitioned table's unique index must include the partition key, which would let the same key through twice in different months. Never partitioned, never dropped with a partition.

AUDIT M4: periodic server-side snapshot of total chip supply components. Absolute conservation is not currently checkable (wallet_transactions is a partial log and there is no trustworthy genesis figure), but conservation BETWEEN snapshots is: delta(holdings) must equal delta(credits - debits). Never make this table client-readable or client-writable.
React error-boundary crashes posted from the browser via /api/client-crash. Service-role only.

First-party client error telemetry from Club Arena browsers. Written only through fn_report_client_errors (auth.uid() server-side, scrubbed, size-capped, rate-limited). Kept 14 days by fn_prune_client_error_events. Sentry is retired and must not be re-added.
KPI sink for the 2026-08-29 open-from-Hub glitch fix. Written by the Club Arena client (ShellTelemetryService); read by v_shell_staleness_rate.
Absolute true accounting record capturing every granular engine action within a table.
Immutable chat ledger for all table messages.
Club-scoped challenges. Was selected by ClubsService.getClubChallenges() but never existed - every club challenge panel threw until 2026-08-17.

Sharded per-club daily hand counters. Never read this directly - read the club_hand_daily view, which sums the shards. Sharded 2026-08-27 because one row per club per day was serialising 460,000 hand inserts a day behind a single row lock.
First-wins record of which invite brought which player to which club. 2026-10-15.
One short invite code per (club, inviter). smarter.poker/i/<code>. 2026-10-15.
Per-club leaderboard payout configuration: currency and the rank->amount prize tables.
Club level 1-55 keyed on member count. min_members is the lowest member count that reaches that level. Single source of truth: the client mirrors these exact numbers in src/utils/clubLevels.ts.

The new-club opening checklist, per club: the optional steps its owner skipped and the latch that finishes the list for good. Written only by fn_club_opening_checklist_skip and fn_club_opening_checklist_complete, read by fn_club_opening_checklist_state. No foreign key to clubs by design (CLAUDE.md DDL rule 7).

Earliest period a standalone club may ever settle. The union equivalent is union_settlement_floor; this is the same concept for club scope. It is DATA an operator moves, and the reason travels with it in the reason column. A period below the floor is HISTORY, not outstanding work: fn_process_weekly_accounting_scope will not let it re-enter the discovery cursor. A club with no row here is unbounded, exactly as before.
Fingerprint (facts, raked hands, attributions) of each complete day fn_club_table_daily_catchup last rebuilt; a day is rebuilt again only when it moves. Migration 20261022062934.

Raked cash-hand totals per (club, table), written by atomic_distribute_rake. A club's rake collected = club_wallets.period_rake_collected (tournament rake and history to 2026-10-02) + the sum of its rows here. Statistic only: no chips are held here.
Prospective lifetime-first owned-club entitlement. No historical backfill; one row per owner forever.
Anti-collusion scan findings. Written by nightly cron + engine telemetry. Reviewed by security/admin team. (Plan § 6.1.8)
Phase 41: individual tables running at a home-game event. An event has 1..N tables, each with its own game_type/stakes/seats.
Reusable game configurations (stakes / buy-in ranges / format) that hosts can apply when creating games. REGULATORY: informational-only, same posture as commander_home_games.

Home poker games organized by user-created groups. REGULATORY POSTURE: Smarter.Poker is NOT a money intermediary for home games. The platform does not take fees, rake, or host commissions; does not escrow or settle buy-ins; does not pay hosts for running games. Financial-looking columns (stakes, buyin_min, buyin_max) are INFORMATIONAL ONLY — used for display and discovery, never for money movement. See also: CHECK constraint no_home_games_source on diamond_transactions.
Phase 37 rate-limit state for track_home_group_share_click. Pruned daily by home-view-log-prune cron (7-day retention). Not user-facing; no RLS policies (service_role only).
Phase 37 rate-limit state for track_home_group_view. Pruned daily by home-view-log-prune cron (7-day retention). Not user-facing; no RLS policies (service_role only).

User-created home-poker groups. Owners/admins manage membership, host games, and run a private social layer. REGULATORY: same informational-only posture as commander_home_games — no money movement, no platform fees, no host compensation from the platform.
Phase 40: rate-limit tracker for join_home_group attempts. Prevents brute-force of private-group invite codes.

Home group roster. SELECT is governed by home_members_host_sees_group (self OR group staff), matching the INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE policies. Do NOT replace this with the Supabase dashboard default "Enable users to view their own data only" - doing so makes hosts unable to read a roster they can still write to. See migration phase50b.

Guest RSVPs for home games. Tracks response, check-in, and flake status for group reputation and rsvp analytics only. REGULATORY: no money is collected, escrowed, or transferred in association with any RSVP.
Phase 41: seat-level pre-game claims. First-come-first-serve via partial unique index on (table_id, seat_number) WHERE status IN (reserved, seated). Post-start, Commander owns live seating.

Live seat map for a game in progress. Tracks who is sitting at which seat, with status (empty/reserved/seated/away) and per-seat notes. REGULATORY: no chip counts, no stack tracking, no settlement — seats are a coordination tool, not a transactional surface.

Rate-limit counters. Access is restricted to postgres/service_role: reads go through fn_try_consume_home_rate_limit (SECURITY DEFINER), no client-side CRUD. BL-2 Pass 47: permissive INSERT policy dropped.

Fleet content ledger: which horse posted which asset (yt:<id> | url:<host><path>). UNIQUE (asset_key, horse_id) is the never-twice-per-horse rule; readers apply the platform-wide window. Writer: workers ContentLedger.ts.
One row per (content, player, view|share). fn_count_content_engagement counts again only when counted_at is a day old. Written only by that function.

Every Diamond Crash round: the seeds, the roll, the crash point (secret until settled), the cap, the auto cash-out, and the settlement. A row is written once at start and settled once; after that it is a fact.
Sampled success and complete failure/recovery telemetry for Table Studio customization. No free-form payload or cosmetic choice is stored.
Server-authoritative challenge reward schedule, seeded verbatim from the client CHALLENGE_POOL. claim_daily_challenge pays from HERE, never from a caller-supplied amount.
D21. Append-only record of every edit to daily_challenge_catalog.
Durable per-player Daily Missions revision cursor. Private Broadcast provides the immediate refresh signal.
One processed freeze entitlement per player, stable streak run, and seven-day threshold. Full inventory still records the threshold so spending later cannot mint it retroactively.
Privacy-safe Daily Missions load, mutation, realtime, navigation, and alert health signals. No free-form payloads.
History of fn_db_saturation_selftest runs. Added 2026-08-22 after the "no tables load" outage so a recurrence is visible in data rather than only in player complaints.
Ops table: alert dedup for deploy-monitor. Auto-cleans expired rows on each insert.
Private fixed boards and road outcomes. Browser access only through owner-scoped RPCs. Seeds and hidden cells remain sealed until settlement.

DR1 / DR13 / D13. A chargeback or refund larger than the balance debits the balance to zero and books the remainder here. The balance is never negative. Nothing in this migration settles a debt: whether the next credit pays it down or it is written off to the house is Dan decision 6.2. Rows are append-only until a human sets settled_at / settled_by.

The per-user, per-engine, per-day earning limit - since ruling 21 the ONLY control that refuses an award. A cap must sit ABOVE the design ceiling of its engine (what a player earns completing everything the game assigns in a day) or it refuses the product rather than limiting abuse. daily_challenges: ceiling 2,969 measured over 7,526 user-days, cap 4,000. catalog_v2: observed maximum 260, cap 500.

One row per host per game (plinko, crash). exposure_allowance_chips is the working capital the host accepts as its maximum exposure: cumulative chips paid may exceed cumulative chips minted by at most this much. cap_fraction is the share of the pool's headroom a single round may be promised. max_multiplier_cents is the ceiling (crash; plinko tables carry their own). growth_k is the crash curve e^(k t).

Plinko and Crash economics per host per game. Invariant, checked on every round and by fn_diamond_game_metrics: chips_paid + reserved_chips <= chips_minted + exposure_allowance_chips. chips_minted is 0.80 of intake; reserved_chips is the largest payout every OPEN crash round could still produce.

DR8 / D16. The diamond store price oracle. Seeded from VALID_DIAMOND_PACKAGES in Smarter-Poker-World-Hub pages/api/store/create-checkout-session.js. The checkout route reads this table and falls back to the constant if it is unreachable; settle_diamond_card_purchase_atomic compares the purchase row to it and files a DR8 warning incident on a mismatch. It never refuses a settle.

D7 / D10. One row per (Stripe dispute id, event). fn_diamond_purchase_dispute claims the PK before any side effect, so a redelivered charge.dispute.* webhook freezes nothing twice and reverses nothing twice.

DR9 / D1. One lot per settled diamond purchase. issued = diamonds_amount + bonus_diamonds at settle. refunded is raised by reconcile_diamond_purchase_refund. consumed is RESERVED and stays 0 until FIFO attribution lands inside the hardened deduct_diamonds (Lane C). Carries no foreign key on purpose: diamond_purchases cascades on profile deletion, so a CASCADE here would erase a paying customer lot (D15) and a RESTRICT here would make account deletion raise.

One promotional issuance budget line per earn engine per period (YYYY-MM). Values are RULING 18 (docs/DIAMOND-RULINGS.md, 2026-09-07): 250,000 a month platform-wide. Log-only until ruling 17 flips refusal on.
D21. Append-only record of every edit to diamond_reward_catalog, with the db role and application that made it.
Daily rollup of how devices drew the Diamond scenes, with no user in it. Written only by fn_record_diamond_scene; read only by fn_diamond_scene_health (platform admins).

DR7. One row per (player, engine, America/Chicago day) with the diamonds that engine credited that player that day. Written by trg_ca_diamond_earn_ledger on diamond_transactions. Horses are players (CLAUDE.md 10.5): this table never filters is_horse.
Phase 80 — best endless-mode streak per (user, variant). Written by pages/hub/trivia/endless.js with onConflict user_id,mode.
Alertmanager webhook deliveries. Durable "did we know?" audit trail for engine freezes and infra alerts. Written by /api/alerts/engine.

Single-row platform maintenance break. Written by the engine at :53 before the hourly :55 restart window and deleted when the break ends. Survives the restart on purpose: the booting engine re-parks its tables until break_ends_at, and browsers seeing 4404 during rehydration read it to show a break screen instead of a dead table. Never gate a table on tables.status = paused instead - cash_tables_needing_engine would abandon the table.

One row per maintenance-break fault, written by the engine through PostgREST as service_role at the moment a break could not proceed. announced_at is the :53 instant of that hour's break; stage is where it failed (announcement, countdown, adoption, boot); outcome is what the engine did about it (cancelled the break, or held it without restarting); error is the engine's own message. fn_ca_record_break_scorecard copies the newest fault for an hour whose break never started into the scorecard detail, and fn_ca_break_scorecard_push names it. Insert-only evidence: service_role may SELECT and INSERT; no browser role may do either.

One row per maintenance break, written by the engine at MaintenanceBreak.end(): tables with a hand in flight when the countdown began, the peak during it, the first instant readyForRestart opened (NULL = never), tables resumed, thaw result. Insert-only, service_role.

One row per maintenance freeze that has been thawed. The primary key on the freeze start instant is what makes the thaw idempotent: two engines racing at the end of a break cannot both shift the clocks.

Per-table presence FSM written by the engine when the table parks for the hourly restart and read once at the next boot (DisconnectEngine.restoreFsmStates). Ignored when older than the freshness window. Engine only.
One row per automatic freeze/pause recovery action taken by the game engine. Written best-effort by ServerTableEngine (service_role).
Periodic engine state checkpoints for resync-on-reconnect. Service-role only.

One row per table currently owned by an engine instance. A lease is live while heartbeat_at is recent; a stale lease may be taken over. Written only by the engine service role. Motivated by the 2026-08-16 dual-container incident.
A player's starred tables. Read by FavoriteTablesWidget in the club lobby.

AUDIT M4: service_role writes only. The 1,049 ledger_reconciliation rows dated 2026-03-13..2026-08-05 predate this and are per-browser artefacts of an RLS-scoped client-side check - 1,039 failed, 10 passed, 199 distinct difference values. Treat that range as noise, not history.
Append-only, compact realtime invalidation feed for authorized Table Management clients.

relations.name: mv_active_poker_locations
relations.view:
SELECT 'venue'::text AS source,
    (pv.id)::text AS entity_id,
    pv.name,
    pv.slug,
    COALESCE(pv.venue_type, 'poker_room'::text) AS venue_type,
    pv.city,
    pv.state,
    (pv.country)::text AS country,
    (COALESCE(pv.lat, pv.latitude))::numeric AS lat,
    (COALESCE(pv.lng, pv.longitude))::numeric AS lng,
    (extensions.st_setsrid(extensions.st_makepoint((COALESCE(pv.lng, pv.longitude))::double precision, (COALESCE(pv.lat, pv.latitude))::double precision), 4326))::extensions.geography AS location_geog,
    COALESCE(pv.profile_photo_url, pv.cover_photo_url, pv.logo_url) AS photo_url,
    pv.tagline,
    (pv.trust_score)::numeric AS activity_score,
    COALESCE(pv.has_tournaments, false) AS has_tournaments,
    COALESCE(pv.is_claimed, false) AS is_verified,
    pv.poker_tables,
    array_to_string(pv.stakes_cash, ', '::text) AS stakes_cash,
    array_to_string(pv.games_offered, ', '::text) AS games_offered,
    NULL::integer AS member_count,
    NULL::integer AS games_hosted,
    NULL::boolean AS is_private,
    now() AS refreshed_at
   FROM public.poker_venues pv
  WHERE ((COALESCE(pv.is_active, true) = true) AND (COALESCE(pv.is_suppressed, false) = false) AND (COALESCE(pv.lat, pv.latitude) IS NOT NULL) AND (COALESCE(pv.lng, pv.longitude) IS NOT NULL) AND (pv.name IS NOT NULL) AND (pv.state IS NOT NULL))
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'home_group'::text AS source,
    (grp.id)::text AS entity_id,
    grp.name,
    sp.slug,
    'home_game'::text AS venue_type,
    grp.city,
    grp.state,
    'US'::text AS country,
    (grp.latitude)::numeric AS lat,
    (grp.longitude)::numeric AS lng,
    grp.location_geog,
    grp.profile_photo_url AS photo_url,
    grp.tagline,
    ((((COALESCE(grp.games_hosted, 0))::numeric * 2.0) + ((COALESCE(grp.member_count, 0))::numeric * 0.5)) + GREATEST((0)::numeric, ((30)::numeric - EXTRACT(day FROM (now() - grp.last_activity_at))))) AS activity_score,
    (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM public.commander_home_games g
          WHERE ((g.group_id = grp.id) AND (g.format = 'tournament'::text) AND (g.scheduled_date >= CURRENT_DATE) AND (g.status = ANY (ARRAY['scheduled'::text, 'confirmed'::text]))))) AS has_tournaments,
    ((grp.profile_photo_url IS NOT NULL) AND (grp.last_activity_at > (now() - '30 days'::interval))) AS is_verified,
    NULL::integer AS poker_tables,
    grp.default_stakes AS stakes_cash,
    grp.default_game_type AS games_offered,
    grp.member_count,
    grp.games_hosted,
    grp.is_private,
    now() AS refreshed_at
   FROM (public.commander_home_groups grp
     LEFT JOIN public.social_pages sp ON (((sp.linked_entity_type = 'home_group'::text) AND (sp.linked_entity_id = (grp.id)::text))))
  WHERE ((grp.is_active = true) AND (NOT grp.is_private) AND (grp.profile_photo_url IS NOT NULL) AND (grp.last_activity_at > (now() - '45 days'::interval)) AND (grp.location_geog IS NOT NULL));

relations.name: mv_home_groups_trending
relations.view:
SELECT id AS group_id,
    name,
    city,
    state,
    is_private,
    profile_photo_url,
    tags,
    location_geog,
    COALESCE(member_count, 0) AS member_count,
    COALESCE(games_hosted, 0) AS games_hosted,
    COALESCE(view_count, 0) AS view_count,
    COALESCE(share_click_count, 0) AS share_click_count,
    COALESCE(( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM (public.commander_home_rsvps r
             JOIN public.commander_home_games hg ON ((hg.id = r.game_id)))
          WHERE ((hg.group_id = g.id) AND (r.response = 'yes'::text) AND (r.responded_at > (now() - '30 days'::interval)))), (0)::bigint) AS recent_rsvps_30d,
    (((((COALESCE(( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM (public.commander_home_rsvps r
             JOIN public.commander_home_games hg ON ((hg.id = r.game_id)))
          WHERE ((hg.group_id = g.id) AND (r.response = 'yes'::text) AND (r.responded_at > (now() - '30 days'::interval)))), (0)::bigint) * 10))::numeric + ((COALESCE(view_count, 0))::numeric * 0.1)) + ((COALESCE(share_click_count, 0) * 2))::numeric) + ((COALESCE(member_count, 0))::numeric * 0.5)) AS trending_score,
    last_activity_at
   FROM public.commander_home_groups g
  WHERE ((is_active = true) AND (is_private = false) AND (profile_photo_url IS NOT NULL) AND (last_activity_at > (now() - '45 days'::interval)))
  ORDER BY (((((COALESCE(( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM (public.commander_home_rsvps r
             JOIN public.commander_home_games hg ON ((hg.id = r.game_id)))
          WHERE ((hg.group_id = g.id) AND (r.response = 'yes'::text) AND (r.responded_at > (now() - '30 days'::interval)))), (0)::bigint) * 10))::numeric + ((COALESCE(view_count, 0))::numeric * 0.1)) + ((COALESCE(share_click_count, 0) * 2))::numeric) + ((COALESCE(member_count, 0))::numeric * 0.5)) DESC;

  WHERE ((bomb_pot IS NOT NULL) AND (jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(winners, '[]'::jsonb)) > 1) AND (COALESCE(pot_size, (0)::numeric) > (0)::numeric) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM public.bomb_pot_award_units a
          WHERE (a.hand_history_id = h.id)))));

relations.name: cron_health
relations.view:
WITH recent AS (
         SELECT d.jobid,
            d.status,
            d.start_time,
            d.return_message
           FROM cron.job_run_details d
          WHERE (d.start_time > (now() - '24:00:00'::interval))
        )
 SELECT j.jobname,
    j.schedule,
    j.active,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (r.status = 'failed'::text)) AS failed_24h,
    count(r.jobid) AS runs_24h,
    round(((100.0 * (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (r.status = 'failed'::text)))::numeric) / (NULLIF(count(r.jobid), 0))::numeric), 2) AS fail_pct_24h,
    max(r.start_time) FILTER (WHERE (r.status = 'failed'::text)) AS last_failure_24h,
    "left"(regexp_replace((array_agg(r.return_message ORDER BY r.start_time DESC) FILTER (WHERE (r.status = 'failed'::text)))[1], '\s+'::text, ' '::text, 'g'::text), 160) AS last_error_24h
   FROM (cron.job j
     LEFT JOIN recent r ON ((r.jobid = j.jobid)))
  GROUP BY j.jobname, j.schedule, j.active;

relations.name: incident_triage
relations.view:
WITH canon AS (
         SELECT ca_drift_incidents.classification,
            ca_drift_incidents.severity,
            regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(ca_drift_incidents.dedupe_key, '^(reconcile|lrl|qr|fa|ca|drift):'::text, ''::text), ':?\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$'::text, ''::text), '_pool(:|$)'::text, '\1'::text), '(:global|:-|:)$'::text, ''::text) AS canon_key,
            round(COALESCE(ca_drift_incidents.discrepancy_amount, (0)::numeric)) AS amount,
            ca_drift_incidents.occurrences,
            ca_drift_incidents.past_target,
            ca_drift_incidents.detected_at,
            ca_drift_incidents.last_seen_at,
            ca_drift_incidents.id,
            ca_drift_incidents.source,
            ca_drift_incidents.suspected_cause
           FROM public.ca_drift_incidents
          WHERE (ca_drift_incidents.status = 'open'::text)
        )
 SELECT classification,
    severity,
    canon_key,
    amount,
    count(*) AS duplicate_incident_rows,
    sum(occurrences) AS total_occurrences,
    bool_or(past_target) AS past_deadline,
    min(detected_at) AS first_seen,
    max(last_seen_at) AS last_seen,
    count(DISTINCT source) AS detectors_reporting,
    (array_agg(suspected_cause ORDER BY last_seen_at DESC) FILTER (WHERE (suspected_cause IS NOT NULL)))[1] AS cause,
    array_agg(id ORDER BY detected_at) AS incident_ids
   FROM canon
  GROUP BY classification, severity, canon_key, amount;

relations.name: incident_worklist
relations.view:
SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY (severity = 'critical'::text) DESC, (abs(amount)) DESC, total_occurrences DESC) AS rank,
    classification,
    severity,
    canon_key,
    amount,
    duplicate_incident_rows,
    total_occurrences,
    past_deadline,
    (first_seen)::date AS since,
    last_seen,
    cause
   FROM ops.incident_triage
  WHERE (severity = ANY (ARRAY['critical'::text, 'warning'::text]))
  ORDER BY (row_number() OVER (ORDER BY (severity = 'critical'::text) DESC, (abs(amount)) DESC, total_occurrences DESC));

relations.name: accounting_payable_earning_sources
relations.view:
SELECT 'cash_rake_accrual'::text AS source_type,
    s.id AS source_id,
    s.rake_record_id,
    NULL::uuid AS tournament_id,
    s.player_id,
    s.club_id,
    s.union_id,
    s.coordinator_union_id,
    s.earned_at,
    s.rake_credit,
    s.contract
   FROM (public.accounting_effective_cash_rake_sources s
     LEFT JOIN public.fn_ca_launch_accounting_club_cutoffs() bd(club_id, cutoff_at) ON ((bd.club_id = s.club_id)))
  WHERE ((bd.cutoff_at IS NULL) OR ((s.earned_at IS NOT NULL) AND isfinite(s.earned_at) AND (s.earned_at >= bd.cutoff_at)))
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'tournament_fee_accrual'::text AS source_type,
    s.id AS source_id,
    s.rake_record_id,
    s.tournament_id,
    s.player_id,
    s.club_id,
    s.union_id,
    s.coordinator_union_id,
    rs.recognized_at AS earned_at,
    s.rake_credit,
    s.contract
   FROM (((public.accounting_tournament_fee_sources s
     JOIN public.accounting_tournament_recognized_sources rs ON (((rs.source_id = s.id) AND (rs.tournament_id = s.tournament_id))))
     JOIN public.accounting_tournament_fee_recognitions r ON ((r.tournament_id = s.tournament_id)))
     LEFT JOIN public.fn_ca_launch_accounting_club_cutoffs() bd(club_id, cutoff_at) ON ((bd.club_id = s.club_id)))
  WHERE (((bd.cutoff_at IS NULL) OR ((s.charged_at IS NOT NULL) AND isfinite(s.charged_at) AND (s.charged_at >= bd.cutoff_at))) AND ((bd.cutoff_at IS NULL) OR ((rs.recognized_at IS NOT NULL) AND isfinite(rs.recognized_at) AND (rs.recognized_at >= bd.cutoff_at))) AND (rs.disposition = 'earned'::text) AND (r.status = 'recognized'::text) AND (rs.rake_credit = s.rake_credit) AND (rs.recognized_at = r.recognized_at) AND (NOT (s.union_id IS DISTINCT FROM r.union_id)));

relations.name: auth_health_view
relations.view:
WITH probe_counts AS (
         SELECT probe_heartbeats.probe_name,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE (probe_heartbeats.occurred_at > (now() - '00:15:00'::interval))) AS runs_15m,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE (probe_heartbeats.occurred_at > (now() - '01:00:00'::interval))) AS runs_1h,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE (probe_heartbeats.occurred_at > (now() - '24:00:00'::interval))) AS runs_24h,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE ((probe_heartbeats.occurred_at > (now() - '00:15:00'::interval)) AND (probe_heartbeats.status = 'ok'::text))) AS ok_15m,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE ((probe_heartbeats.occurred_at > (now() - '01:00:00'::interval)) AND (probe_heartbeats.status = 'failed'::text))) AS failed_1h,
            max(probe_heartbeats.occurred_at) AS last_run_at
           FROM public.probe_heartbeats
          GROUP BY probe_heartbeats.probe_name
        )
 SELECT COALESCE(( SELECT probe_counts.runs_15m
           FROM probe_counts
          WHERE (probe_counts.probe_name = 'signup-probe'::text)), (0)::bigint) AS signup_runs_15m,
    COALESCE(( SELECT probe_counts.ok_15m
           FROM probe_counts
          WHERE (probe_counts.probe_name = 'signup-probe'::text)), (0)::bigint) AS signup_ok_15m,
    COALESCE(( SELECT probe_counts.failed_1h
           FROM probe_counts
          WHERE (probe_counts.probe_name = 'signup-probe'::text)), (0)::bigint) AS signup_failed_1h,
    ( SELECT probe_counts.last_run_at
           FROM probe_counts
          WHERE (probe_counts.probe_name = 'signup-probe'::text)) AS signup_last_run,
    COALESCE(( SELECT probe_counts.runs_15m
           FROM probe_counts
          WHERE (probe_counts.probe_name = 'login-probe'::text)), (0)::bigint) AS login_runs_15m,
    COALESCE(( SELECT probe_counts.ok_15m
           FROM probe_counts
          WHERE (probe_counts.probe_name = 'login-probe'::text)), (0)::bigint) AS login_ok_15m,
    COALESCE(( SELECT probe_counts.failed_1h
           FROM probe_counts
          WHERE (probe_counts.probe_name = 'login-probe'::text)), (0)::bigint) AS login_failed_1h,
    ( SELECT probe_counts.last_run_at
           FROM probe_counts
          WHERE (probe_counts.probe_name = 'login-probe'::text)) AS login_last_run,
    COALESCE(( SELECT probe_counts.runs_15m
           FROM probe_counts
          WHERE (probe_counts.probe_name = 'recovery-probe'::text)), (0)::bigint) AS recovery_runs_15m,
    COALESCE(( SELECT probe_counts.ok_15m
           FROM probe_counts
          WHERE (probe_counts.probe_name = 'recovery-probe'::text)), (0)::bigint) AS recovery_ok_15m,
    COALESCE(( SELECT probe_counts.failed_1h
           FROM probe_counts
          WHERE (probe_counts.probe_name = 'recovery-probe'::text)), (0)::bigint) AS recovery_failed_1h,
    ( SELECT probe_counts.last_run_at
           FROM probe_counts
          WHERE (probe_counts.probe_name = 'recovery-probe'::text)) AS recovery_last_run,
    COALESCE(( SELECT probe_counts.runs_24h
           FROM probe_counts
          WHERE (probe_counts.probe_name = 'auth-integrity-audit'::text)), (0)::bigint) AS integrity_runs_24h,
    COALESCE(( SELECT probe_counts.failed_1h
           FROM probe_counts
          WHERE (probe_counts.probe_name = 'auth-integrity-audit'::text)), (0)::bigint) AS integrity_failed_1h,
    ( SELECT probe_counts.last_run_at
           FROM probe_counts
          WHERE (probe_counts.probe_name = 'auth-integrity-audit'::text)) AS integrity_last_run,
    COALESCE(( SELECT probe_counts.runs_24h
           FROM probe_counts
          WHERE (probe_counts.probe_name = 'email-deliverability'::text)), (0)::bigint) AS email_runs_24h,
    COALESCE(( SELECT probe_counts.failed_1h
           FROM probe_counts
          WHERE (probe_counts.probe_name = 'email-deliverability'::text)), (0)::bigint) AS email_failed_1h,
    ( SELECT probe_counts.last_run_at
           FROM probe_counts
          WHERE (probe_counts.probe_name = 'email-deliverability'::text)) AS email_last_run,
    ( SELECT signup_health_view.new_users_24h
           FROM public.signup_health_view) AS real_signups_24h,
    ( SELECT signup_health_view.new_users_1h
           FROM public.signup_health_view) AS real_signups_1h,
    ( SELECT signup_health_view.errors_1h
           FROM public.signup_health_view) AS trigger_errors_1h,
    now() AS computed_at;

   FROM public.club_members cm
  WHERE ((cm.club_id = bbj_daily_user.club_id) AND (cm.user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (lower(COALESCE(cm.role, ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['owner'::text, 'co_owner'::text, 'admin'::text, 'manager'::text]))))) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (public.union_clubs uc
     JOIN public.unions u ON ((u.id = uc.union_id)))
  WHERE ((uc.club_id = bbj_daily_user.club_id) AND (u.owner_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))))) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (public.union_clubs uc
     JOIN public.union_admins ua ON ((ua.union_id = uc.union_id)))
  WHERE ((uc.club_id = bbj_daily_user.club_id) AND (ua.user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))))))

policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM public.club_members cm
  WHERE ((cm.club_id = blacklists.club_id) AND (cm.user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (cm.role = ANY (ARRAY['owner'::text, 'co_owner'::text, 'admin'::text, 'super_agent'::text])))))

policies.name: blacklists_insert
policies.check:
((banned_by = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM public.club_members cm
  WHERE ((cm.club_id = blacklists.club_id) AND (cm.user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (cm.role = ANY (ARRAY['owner'::text, 'co_owner'::text, 'admin'::text, 'super_agent'::text]))))))

policies.name: blacklists_select
policies.using:
((EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM public.club_members cm

relations.name: ca_cash_pot_check_anomalies
relations.view:
SELECT d.check_id,
    d.ordinal,
    d.condition_kind,
    d.hand_id,
    d.table_id,
    d.hand_number,
    d.created_at,
    d.pot,
    d.rake,
    d.bbj,
    d.recorded_awarded,
    d.winner_count,
    d.winner_state,
    d.signed_residual,
    d.absolute_residual,
    d.evidence_bytes
   FROM (public.ca_cash_pot_check_evidence h
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_to_recordset(h.anomalies) d(check_id uuid, ordinal integer, condition_kind text, hand_id uuid, table_id uuid, hand_number integer, created_at timestamp with time zone, pot numeric, rake numeric, bbj numeric, recorded_awarded numeric, winner_count integer, winner_state text, signed_residual numeric, absolute_residual numeric, evidence_bytes integer));

relations.name: ca_diamond_dead_store_writes
relations.view:
SELECT d.store,
    d.dead_column,
    d.holdings_at_2026_09_03,
    COALESCE(s.n_tup_ins, (0)::bigint) AS n_tup_ins,
    COALESCE(s.n_tup_upd, (0)::bigint) AS n_tup_upd,
    COALESCE(s.n_tup_del, (0)::bigint) AS n_tup_del,
    ((COALESCE(s.n_tup_ins, (0)::bigint) + COALESCE(s.n_tup_upd, (0)::bigint)) + COALESCE(s.n_tup_del, (0)::bigint)) AS writes,
    s.last_autoanalyze,
    s.last_autovacuum,
    d.writer_evidence
   FROM (( VALUES ('diamond_ledger'::text,'(the whole table)'::text,'0 rows all time'::text,'One function names it, complete_daily_challenge, which is EXECUTE-granted to postgres and service_role only. The live daily-challenge path is claim_daily_challenge(s), which journals to diamond_transactions.'::text), ('user_progress'::text,'diamonds'::text,'107 rows, 10,700 diamonds'::text,'create_user_progress_on_signup is the only writer and is attached to NO trigger (pg_trigger scan, 2026-09-03). A fossil of the pre-profiles balance.'::text), ('bot_profiles'::text,'diamonds'::text,'100 rows, 26,541 diamonds'::text,'No function in the database inserts, updates or deletes this relation.'::text), ('club_members'::text,'diamonds'::text,'0 diamonds across 1,935 rows'::text,'No function writes club_members.diamonds. Two bodies match a naive club_members-near-set-diamonds scan (fn_atomic_buyin, fn_union_send_to_member_zd3core) and BOTH write profiles.diamonds; the column is a false positive. club_members.chip_balance is written constantly and is not this column.'::text), ('club_memberships'::text,'diamonds'::text,'0 diamonds'::text,'No function in the database names this relation at all.'::text), ('club_diamond_wallets'::text,'balance'::text,'2 rows, 0.00'::text,'One function names it (ca_promo_vault_buy). Both rows have held 0.00 since creation.'::text)) d(store, dead_column, holdings_at_2026_09_03, writer_evidence)
     LEFT JOIN pg_stat_user_tables s ON (((s.schemaname = 'public'::name) AND (s.relname = d.store))));

constraints.name: ca_diamond_economics_choice_is_an_option
constraints.definition:
CHECK (((units <> 'choice'::text) OR
CASE name
    WHEN 'guarantee_covers'::text THEN (value_text = ANY (ARRAY['prize_pool_only'::text, 'prize_pool_and_bounties'::text]))
    WHEN 'guarantee_funding_moment'::text THEN (value_text = ANY (ARRAY['set_aside_at_creation'::text, 'checked_at_creation_paid_at_close'::text]))
    WHEN 'freeroll_rebuy_cost'::text THEN (value_text = ANY (ARRAY['none_offered'::text, 'one_diamond_to_the_prize_pool'::text, 'one_hundred_diamonds_to_the_prize_pool'::text]))
    WHEN 'freeroll_addon_cost'::text THEN (value_text = ANY (ARRAY['none_offered'::text, 'one_diamond_to_the_prize_pool'::text, 'one_hundred_diamonds_to_the_prize_pool'::text]))
    WHEN 'promo_entry_refund_destination'::text THEN (value_text = ANY (ARRAY['funding_account'::text, 'unused_promotional_entry'::text, 'player_wallet'::text]))
    WHEN 'horse_entry_funding'::text THEN (value_text = ANY (ARRAY['own_balance'::text, 'funding_account'::text]))
    WHEN 'cash_rake_rounding'::text THEN (value_text = ANY (ARRAY['down'::text, 'nearest'::text, 'up'::text]))
    ELSE false
END))

constraints.name: ca_diamond_economics_name_is_a_question
constraints.definition: CHECK (((name = ANY (ARRAY['guarantee_overlay_account'::text, 'guarantee_mint_may_issue'::text, 'guarantee_mint_monthly_ceiling'::text, 'guarantee_max_per_event'::text, 'guarantee_max_outstanding'::text, 'guarantee_covers'::text, 'guarantee_funding_moment'::text, 'guarantee_cap_refuses_creation'::text, 'guarantee_authority'::text, 'freeroll_allowed'::text, 'freeroll_rebuy_cost'::text, 'freeroll_addon_cost'::text, 'promo_entry_allowed'::text, 'promo_entry_per_player_per_day'::text, 'promo_entry_per_event'::text, 'promo_entry_monthly_diamonds'::text, 'promo_entry_refund_destination'::text, 'promo_entry_expiry_days'::text, 'horse_entry_funding'::text, 'horse_overlay_autofill'::text, 'horse_freeroll_autofill'::text, 'tournament_fee_percent'::text, 'tournament_fee_percent_heads_up'::text, 'tournament_rebuy_fee_percent'::text, 'tournament_reentry_fee_percent'::text, 'tournament_addon_fee_percent'::text, 'tournament_fee_destination'::text, 'cash_rake_enabled'::text, 'cash_rake_percent'::text, 'cash_rake_cap'::text, 'cash_rake_percent_heads_up'::text, 'cash_rake_cap_heads_up'::text, 'cash_rake_percent_three_handed'::text, 'cash_rake_cap_three_handed'::text, 'cash_rake_no_flop_no_drop'::text, 'cash_rake_min_pot'::text, 'cash_rake_rounding'::text, 'cash_rake_destination'::text, 'rakeback_percent'::text, 'rakeback_period'::text, 'rake_earns_vip_points'::text, 'bbj_enabled'::text, 'bbj_drop_per_hand'::text, 'bbj_qualifying_hand'::text, 'bbj_excluded_games'::text, 'bbj_min_pot'::text, 'bbj_min_dealt_in'::text, 'bbj_pool_split'::text, 'bbj_hit_shares'::text, 'bbj_seed'::text, 'bbj_seed_account'::text, 'bbj_pool_ceiling'::text, 'bbj_pool_ceiling_destination'::text, 'bbj_withdrawal_destination'::text, 'chip_account_may_fund_a_diamond_format'::text])) OR (name = ANY (ARRAY['mini_bbj_enabled'::text, 'mini_bbj_amount'::text, 'mini_bbj_reserve_floor'::text])))) NOT VALID

constraints.name: ca_diamond_economics_one_value
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((units = ANY (ARRAY['diamonds'::text, 'diamonds_per_month'::text, 'diamonds_per_event'::text, 'diamonds_per_rebuy'::text, 'diamonds_per_addon'::text, 'diamonds_per_hand'::text, 'entries_per_player_per_day'::text, 'entries_per_event'::text, 'days'::text, 'percent'::text, 'players'::text, 'big_blinds'::text])) AND (value IS NOT NULL) AND (value_text IS NULL)) OR ((units = ANY (ARRAY['boolean'::text, 'account'::text, 'choice'::text, 'role'::text, 'hand'::text, 'game_list'::text, 'shares'::text, 'period'::text])) AND (value_text IS NOT NULL) AND (btrim(value_text) <> ''::text) AND (value IS NULL)))) NOT VALID

constraints.definition: CHECK (((value IS NULL) OR ((value >= (0)::numeric) AND ((units = 'percent'::text) OR (value = trunc(value))) AND ((units <> 'percent'::text) OR (value <= (100)::numeric)))))

relations.name: ca_direct_balance_writes
relations.view:
SELECT created_at AS at,
    'club_members'::text AS table_name,
        CASE
            WHEN (to_type = 'player_wallet'::text) THEN to_entity_id
            ELSE from_entity_id
        END AS user_id,
        CASE
            WHEN (to_type = 'player_wallet'::text) THEN amount
            ELSE (- amount)
        END AS delta,
    actor_service AS application_name,
    db_role,
    club_id,
    tournament_id,
    id AS ledger_id,
    description
   FROM public.chip_ledger l
  WHERE ((category = 'adjustment'::text) AND (description ~~ 'auto-audited club_members.chip_balance delta%'::text) AND (description !~~ '%rejected)'::text));

relations.name: ca_launch_bbj_reporting_contributions
relations.view:
WITH starts AS (
         SELECT r.row_key,
            max(o.captured_at) AS s
           FROM (public.ca_launch_reset_operations o
             JOIN public.ca_launch_reset_rows r ON ((r.operation_id = o.operation_id)))
          WHERE ((o.state = 'executed'::text) AND (r.relation_name = 'bbj_pools'::text))
          GROUP BY r.row_key
        )
 SELECT c.id,
    c.pool_id,
    c.club_id,
    c.table_id,
    c.hand_number,
    c.amount,
    c.big_blind,
    c.stakes_tier,
    c.created_at,
    c.main_portion,
    c.backup_portion,
    c.promo_portion,
    c.hand_id
   FROM (public.bbj_contributions c
     LEFT JOIN starts st ON ((st.row_key = jsonb_build_object('id', c.pool_id))))
  WHERE (c.created_at >= COALESCE(st.s, '-infinity'::timestamp with time zone));

relations.name: ca_launch_bbj_reporting_winners
relations.view:
WITH starts AS (
         SELECT r.row_key,
            max(o.captured_at) AS s
           FROM (public.ca_launch_reset_operations o
             JOIN public.ca_launch_reset_rows r ON ((r.operation_id = o.operation_id)))
          WHERE ((o.state = 'executed'::text) AND (r.relation_name = 'bbj_pools'::text))
          GROUP BY r.row_key
        )
 SELECT w.id,
    w.club_id,
    w.pool_id,
    w.loser_id,
    w.winner_id,
    w.loser_hand,
    w.winner_hand,
    w.loser_payout,
    w.winner_payout,
    w.table_share_payout,
    w.total_payout,
    w.pool_amount_at_hit,
    w.stakes_tier,
    w.table_id,
    w.hand_number,
    w.awarded_at,
    w.winner_display_name,
    w.loser_display_name,
    w.kind
   FROM (public.bbj_winners w
     LEFT JOIN starts st ON ((st.row_key = jsonb_build_object('id', w.pool_id))))
  WHERE (w.awarded_at >= COALESCE(st.s, '-infinity'::timestamp with time zone));

columns.name: origin
columns.default:
CASE
    WHEN (op_id ~~ 'ledger:%'::text) THEN 'journal'::text
    WHEN (op_id ~~ 'register-opening-baseline:%'::text) THEN 'baseline'::text
    WHEN (op_id ~~ 'register-opening-baseline-correction:%'::text) THEN 'baseline'::text
    WHEN (op_id ~~ 'baseline:%'::text) THEN 'baseline'::text
    WHEN (op_id ~~ 'diamond-mint:%'::text) THEN 'diamond-mint'::text
    WHEN (op_id ~~ 'club-opening-grant:%'::text) THEN 'opening-grant'::text
    WHEN (op_id ~~ 'seat_credit_erased:%'::text) THEN 'restoration'::text
    WHEN (op_id ~~ 'seed:%'::text) THEN 'seed'::text
    WHEN (op_id ~~ 'deletion:%'::text) THEN 'deletion'::text
    WHEN (op_id ~~ 'diamond-journal:purchase:%'::text) THEN 'purchase'::text
    WHEN (op_id ~~ 'diamond-journal:reward:%'::text) THEN 'reward'::text
    WHEN (op_id ~~ 'diamond-journal:promotion:%'::text) THEN 'promotion'::text
    WHEN (op_id ~~ 'diamond-journal:refund:%'::text) THEN 'refund'::text
    WHEN (op_id ~~ 'diamond-journal:spend:%'::text) THEN 'spend'::text
    WHEN (op_id ~~ 'diamond-journal:bridge:%'::text) THEN 'bridge'::text
    WHEN (op_id ~~ 'diamond-journal:adjustment:%'::text) THEN 'adjustment'::text
    WHEN (op_id ~~ 'diamond-journal:arena:%'::text) THEN 'arena'::text
    WHEN (op_id ~~ 'diamond-journal:%'::text) THEN 'unclassified'::text
    ELSE 'operator'::text
END

relations.view:
SELECT cash_seat_move_receipts.move_id,
    cash_seat_move_receipts.player_id,
    cash_seat_move_receipts.game_id,
    cash_seat_move_receipts.club_id,
    cash_seat_move_receipts.from_table_id AS table_id,
    cash_seat_move_receipts.source_occupancy_id AS occupancy_id,
    (- cash_seat_move_receipts.amount) AS amount,
    'source'::text AS side,
    cash_seat_move_receipts.created_at
   FROM public.cash_seat_move_receipts
UNION ALL
 SELECT cash_seat_move_receipts.move_id,
    cash_seat_move_receipts.player_id,
    cash_seat_move_receipts.game_id,
    cash_seat_move_receipts.club_id,
    cash_seat_move_receipts.to_table_id AS table_id,
    cash_seat_move_receipts.destination_occupancy_id AS occupancy_id,

    'destination'::text AS side,
    cash_seat_move_receipts.created_at
   FROM public.cash_seat_move_receipts;

constraints.name: chip_ledger_positive_amount

constraints.definition: CHECK (((created_at < '2026-09-07 22:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone) OR (amount = round(amount, 2)))) NOT VALID

relations.view:
SELECT date_bin('00:10:00'::interval, received_at, '2000-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone) AS bucket_start,
    code,
    (count(*))::integer AS reports,
    (sum(occurrences))::integer AS occurrences,
    (count(DISTINCT user_id))::integer AS users
   FROM public.client_error_events
  WHERE ((received_at > (now() - '24:00:00'::interval)) AND (NOT automated))
  GROUP BY (date_bin('00:10:00'::interval, received_at, '2000-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone)), code;

    sub_agent_count,
    COALESCE(weekly_rake_generated, (0)::numeric) AS weekly_rake_generated,
    COALESCE(lifetime_rake_generated, (0)::numeric) AS lifetime_rake_generated,
    created_at,
    updated_at
   FROM public.agents;

relations.name: club_daily_stats
relations.view:
WITH rr_start AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(min(rake_records.created_at), 'infinity'::timestamp with time zone) AS ts
           FROM public.rake_records
        )
 SELECT club_id,
    stat_date,
    (sum(hands_played))::integer AS hands_played,
    sum(rake_collected) AS rake_collected
   FROM ( SELECT rake_records.club_id,
            (rake_records.created_at)::date AS stat_date,
            count(*) AS hands_played,
            sum(rake_records.rake_amount) AS rake_collected
           FROM public.rake_records
          GROUP BY rake_records.club_id, ((rake_records.created_at)::date)
        UNION ALL
         SELECT rake_history.club_id,
            (COALESCE(rake_history.collected_at, rake_history.created_at))::date AS "coalesce",
            count(*) AS count,
            sum(rake_history.rake_amount) AS sum
           FROM public.rake_history,
            rr_start
          WHERE (COALESCE(rake_history.collected_at, rake_history.created_at) < rr_start.ts)
          GROUP BY rake_history.club_id, ((COALESCE(rake_history.collected_at, rake_history.created_at))::date)) u
  GROUP BY club_id, stat_date;

policies.name: home_reports_host_sees_group_content
policies.using:
((( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid) IS NOT NULL) AND public.fn_home_is_group_staff(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid),
CASE reported_type
    WHEN 'post'::text THEN ( SELECT commander_home_posts.group_id
       FROM public.commander_home_posts
      WHERE (commander_home_posts.id = commander_home_content_reports.reported_id))
    WHEN 'comment'::text THEN ( SELECT p.group_id
       FROM (public.commander_home_post_comments c
         JOIN public.commander_home_posts p ON ((p.id = c.post_id)))
      WHERE (c.id = commander_home_content_reports.reported_id))
    WHEN 'review'::text THEN ( SELECT g.group_id
       FROM (public.commander_home_game_reviews r
         JOIN public.commander_home_games g ON ((g.id = r.game_id)))
      WHERE (r.id = commander_home_content_reports.reported_id))
    WHEN 'game'::text THEN ( SELECT commander_home_games.group_id
       FROM public.commander_home_games
      WHERE (commander_home_games.id = commander_home_content_reports.reported_id))
    WHEN 'member'::text THEN ( SELECT commander_home_members.group_id
       FROM public.commander_home_members
      WHERE (commander_home_members.id = commander_home_content_reports.reported_id))
    ELSE NULL::uuid
END))

    plinko_drops.bet_diamonds,
    plinko_drops.bet_chips,
    plinko_drops.payout_chips,
    plinko_drops.created_at,
    plinko_drops.created_at AS settled_at,
    'cashed'::text AS status,
    plinko_drops.is_fixture,
    (plinko_drops.multiplier_cents)::numeric AS multiplier_cents,
    plinko_drops.table_version,
    plinko_drops.capped AS constrained
   FROM public.plinko_drops
UNION ALL
 SELECT crash_rounds.id,
    crash_rounds.host_id,
    crash_rounds.club_id,
    crash_rounds.user_id,
    'crash'::text AS game,
    crash_rounds.bet_diamonds,
    crash_rounds.bet_chips,
    crash_rounds.payout_chips,
    crash_rounds.started_at AS created_at,
    crash_rounds.settled_at,
    crash_rounds.status,
    crash_rounds.is_fixture,
    (crash_rounds.cashout_cents)::numeric AS multiplier_cents,
    NULL::integer AS table_version,
    false AS constrained
   FROM public.crash_rounds
UNION ALL
 SELECT diamond_choice_rounds.id,
    diamond_choice_rounds.host_id,
    diamond_choice_rounds.club_id,
    diamond_choice_rounds.user_id,
    diamond_choice_rounds.game,
    diamond_choice_rounds.bet_diamonds,
    diamond_choice_rounds.bet_chips,
    diamond_choice_rounds.payout_chips,
    diamond_choice_rounds.created_at,
    diamond_choice_rounds.settled_at,
    diamond_choice_rounds.status,
    diamond_choice_rounds.is_fixture,
        CASE
            WHEN (diamond_choice_rounds.status = 'cashed'::text) THEN ((diamond_choice_rounds.payout_chips / diamond_choice_rounds.bet_chips) * (100)::numeric)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS multiplier_cents,
    NULL::integer AS table_version,
    false AS constrained
   FROM public.diamond_choice_rounds
UNION ALL
 SELECT diamond_bonus_entries.id,
    diamond_bonus_entries.host_id,
    diamond_bonus_entries.club_id,
    diamond_bonus_entries.user_id,
    diamond_bonus_entries.game,
    diamond_bonus_entries.total_diamonds AS bet_diamonds,
    ((diamond_bonus_entries.total_diamonds)::numeric / (((diamond_bonus_entries.result ->> 'diamonds_per_chip'::text))::integer)::numeric) AS bet_chips,
    ((diamond_bonus_entries.result ->> 'payout_chips'::text))::numeric AS payout_chips,
    diamond_bonus_entries.created_at,
    diamond_bonus_entries.created_at AS settled_at,
    'cashed'::text AS status,
    diamond_bonus_entries.is_fixture,
    NULL::numeric AS multiplier_cents,
    ((diamond_bonus_entries.result ->> 'table_version'::text))::integer AS table_version,
    false AS constrained
   FROM public.diamond_bonus_entries
  WHERE ((diamond_bonus_entries.game = 'plinko'::text) AND (diamond_bonus_entries.result IS NOT NULL));

CHECK ((
CASE
    WHEN (status = 'open'::text) THEN pending_diamonds
    ELSE settled_net
END = (((((((entry_diamonds + bonus_diamonds) + mint_entry_diamonds) - diamond_prizes) - throwables) - time_banks) - rabbit_hunts) - other_expenses)))

constraints.definition: CHECK ((((game_family = 'cash'::text) AND (objective = 'cash_ev'::text)) OR ((game_family = 'tourney_icm'::text) AND (objective = 'icm'::text)) OR ((game_family = 'tourney_ev'::text) AND (objective = 'chip_ev'::text)) OR ((game_family = 'spin'::text) AND (objective = ANY (ARRAY['chip_ev'::text, 'icm'::text])))))

constraints.name: gto_v31_runtime_cells_check3
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((objective = 'cash_ev'::text) AND (utility_context = 'cash_ev'::text)) OR ((objective = 'chip_ev'::text) AND (utility_context = 'chip_ev'::text)) OR ((objective = 'icm'::text) AND (game_family = 'spin'::text) AND (utility_context = 'spin_ladder'::text)) OR ((objective = 'icm'::text) AND (game_family = 'tourney_icm'::text) AND (utility_context = ANY (ARRAY['satellite'::text, 'bubble'::text, 'final_table'::text, 'in_money'::text, 'ladder'::text])))))

constraints.name: gto_v31_runtime_cells_check4
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((node_role = ANY (ARRAY['open'::text, 'cbet'::text, 'probe'::text, 'delayed_cbet'::text, 'barrel'::text])) AND (facing_kind = 'none'::text) AND (facing_size_bucket = 'none'::text)) OR ((node_role = 'all_in'::text) AND (facing_kind = 'all_in'::text) AND (facing_size_bucket = 'all_in'::text)) OR ((node_role = 'facing_bet'::text) AND (facing_kind = 'bet'::text) AND (facing_size_bucket = ANY (ARRAY['small'::text, 'mid'::text, 'big'::text]))) OR ((node_role = ANY (ARRAY['facing_raise'::text, 'check_raise'::text, 'bet_raise'::text])) AND (facing_kind = 'raise'::text) AND (facing_size_bucket = ANY (ARRAY['small'::text, 'mid'::text, 'big'::text])))))

    g.default_game_type,

    g.tagline,
    g.club_code,
    g.invite_code

relations.name: home_game_members
relations.view:
SELECT m.id,
    m.group_id,
    m.user_id,
        CASE
            WHEN (m.role = 'owner'::text) THEN 'host'::text
            ELSE m.role
        END AS role,
        CASE
            WHEN (m.status = 'approved'::text) THEN 'active'::text
            ELSE m.status
        END AS status,
    m.joined_at
   FROM (public.commander_home_members m
     JOIN public.commander_home_groups g ON ((g.id = m.group_id)))
  WHERE (((g.is_private = false) AND (g.is_active = true) AND (m.status = 'approved'::text)) OR ((auth.uid() IS NOT NULL) AND (m.user_id = auth.uid())) OR ((auth.uid() IS NOT NULL) AND public.fn_home_is_group_staff(auth.uid(), m.group_id)));

relations.name: horse_hand_results
relations.view:
WITH hand_actions AS (
         SELECT h_1.id AS hand_id,
            h_1.created_at,
            h_1.game_variant,
            h_1.big_blind,
            (a.e ->> 'userId'::text) AS user_id,
            (a.e ->> 'stage'::text) AS stage,
            (a.e ->> 'action'::text) AS action,
            ((a.e ->> 'amount'::text))::numeric AS amount,
            a.i AS idx
           FROM (public.hand_history h_1
             CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(h_1.actions) WITH ORDINALITY a(e, i))
          WHERE ((h_1.tournament_id IS NULL) AND (h_1.created_at > (now() - '24:00:00'::interval)))
        ), last_aggr AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (hand_actions.hand_id, hand_actions.user_id, hand_actions.stage) hand_actions.hand_id,
            hand_actions.user_id,
            hand_actions.stage,
            hand_actions.amount AS aggr_total,
            hand_actions.idx AS aggr_idx
           FROM hand_actions
          WHERE (hand_actions.action = ANY (ARRAY['bet'::text, 'raise'::text, 'all_in'::text]))
          ORDER BY hand_actions.hand_id, hand_actions.user_id, hand_actions.stage, hand_actions.idx DESC
        ), calls_after AS (
         SELECT c.hand_id,
            c.user_id,
            c.stage,
            sum(c.amount) AS call_sum
           FROM (hand_actions c
             LEFT JOIN last_aggr la ON (((la.hand_id = c.hand_id) AND (la.user_id = c.user_id) AND (la.stage = c.stage))))
          WHERE ((c.action = 'call'::text) AND (c.idx > COALESCE(la.aggr_idx, (0)::bigint)))
          GROUP BY c.hand_id, c.user_id, c.stage
        ), street_keys AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT hand_actions.hand_id,
            hand_actions.user_id,
            hand_actions.stage
           FROM hand_actions
          WHERE (hand_actions.action = ANY (ARRAY['bet'::text, 'raise'::text, 'all_in'::text, 'call'::text]))
        ), invested_raw AS (
         SELECT sk.hand_id,
            sk.user_id,
            sum((COALESCE(la.aggr_total, (0)::numeric) + COALESCE(ca.call_sum, (0)::numeric))) AS invested
           FROM ((street_keys sk
             LEFT JOIN last_aggr la ON (((la.hand_id = sk.hand_id) AND (la.user_id = sk.user_id) AND (la.stage = sk.stage))))
             LEFT JOIN calls_after ca ON (((ca.hand_id = sk.hand_id) AND (ca.user_id = sk.user_id) AND (ca.stage = sk.stage))))
          GROUP BY sk.hand_id, sk.user_id
        ), invested_ranked AS (
         SELECT invested_raw.hand_id,
            invested_raw.user_id,
            invested_raw.invested,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY invested_raw.hand_id ORDER BY invested_raw.invested DESC, invested_raw.user_id) AS rn,
            lead(invested_raw.invested) OVER (PARTITION BY invested_raw.hand_id ORDER BY invested_raw.invested DESC, invested_raw.user_id) AS next_inv
           FROM invested_raw
        ), invested AS (
         SELECT invested_ranked.hand_id,
            invested_ranked.user_id,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((invested_ranked.rn = 1) AND (invested_ranked.next_inv IS NOT NULL) AND (invested_ranked.next_inv < invested_ranked.invested)) THEN invested_ranked.next_inv
                    ELSE invested_ranked.invested
                END AS invested
           FROM invested_ranked
        ), won AS (
         SELECT h_1.id AS hand_id,
            (w_1.e ->> 'userId'::text) AS user_id,
            sum(((w_1.e ->> 'amount'::text))::numeric) AS won
           FROM (public.hand_history h_1
             CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(h_1.winners) w_1(e))
          WHERE ((h_1.tournament_id IS NULL) AND (h_1.created_at > (now() - '24:00:00'::interval)))
          GROUP BY h_1.id, (w_1.e ->> 'userId'::text)
        )
 SELECT i.hand_id,
    i.user_id,
    h.created_at,
    h.game_variant,
    h.big_blind,
    (COALESCE(w.won, (0)::numeric) - i.invested) AS net,
    ((COALESCE(w.won, (0)::numeric) - i.invested) / NULLIF(h.big_blind, (0)::numeric)) AS net_bb
   FROM ((invested i
     JOIN public.hand_history h ON ((h.id = i.hand_id)))
     LEFT JOIN won w ON (((w.hand_id = i.hand_id) AND (w.user_id = i.user_id))));

relations.view:
SELECT (p.horse_profile ->> 'style'::text) AS style,
    r.game_variant,
    count(*) AS hands,
    round(sum(r.net), 2) AS net_chips,
    round(((sum(r.net_bb) / (NULLIF(count(*), 0))::numeric) * (100)::numeric), 2) AS bb_per_100
   FROM (public.horse_hand_results r
     JOIN public.profiles p ON (((p.id = (r.user_id)::uuid) AND (p.is_horse = true))))
  GROUP BY (p.horse_profile ->> 'style'::text), r.game_variant;

relations.name: live_stream_analytics
relations.view:
SELECT id,
    broadcaster_id,
    title,
    category,
    started_at,
    ended_at,
    peak_viewers,
    viewer_count,
    COALESCE(( SELECT (count(*))::integer AS count
           FROM public.live_reactions lr
          WHERE (lr.stream_id = ls.id)), 0) AS reaction_count,
    (EXTRACT(epoch FROM (ended_at - started_at)))::integer AS duration_seconds,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM public.live_comments lc
          WHERE (lc.stream_id = ls.id)) AS comment_count,
    ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(lg.amount), (0)::bigint) AS "coalesce"
           FROM public.live_gifts lg

relations.name: mv_active_poker_locations
relations.view:
SELECT source,
    entity_id,
    name,
    slug,
    venue_type,
    city,
    state,
    country,
    lat,
    lng,
    location_geog,
    photo_url,
    tagline,
    activity_score,
    has_tournaments,
    is_verified,
    poker_tables,
    stakes_cash,
    games_offered,
    member_count,
    games_hosted,
    is_private,
    refreshed_at
   FROM discovery_private.mv_active_poker_locations cache
  WHERE ((source = 'venue'::text) OR ((source = 'home_group'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM public.commander_home_groups current_group
          WHERE ((current_group.id =
                CASE
                    WHEN (cache.source = 'home_group'::text) THEN (cache.entity_id)::uuid
                    ELSE NULL::uuid
                END) AND (current_group.is_active IS TRUE) AND (current_group.is_private IS FALSE) AND (current_group.profile_photo_url IS NOT NULL) AND (current_group.last_activity_at > (now() - '45 days'::interval)) AND (current_group.location_geog IS NOT NULL))))));

SELECT group_id,

   FROM discovery_private.mv_home_groups_trending cache
  WHERE (EXISTS ( SELECT 1

          WHERE ((current_group.id = cache.group_id) AND (current_group.is_active IS TRUE) AND (current_group.is_private IS FALSE) AND (current_group.profile_photo_url IS NOT NULL) AND (current_group.last_activity_at > (now() - '45 days'::interval)))));

    sum(videos_created) AS total_videos,
    sum(errors) AS total_errors,

triggers.name: profile_account_changed
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER profile_account_changed AFTER UPDATE OF username, display_name, alias, first_name, last_name, full_name, display_name_preference, use_real_name, bio, player_tags, login_streak, vip_tier, settings, diamonds ON public.profiles FOR EACH ROW WHEN (((((((((((((((((old.username IS DISTINCT FROM new.username) OR (old.display_name IS DISTINCT FROM new.display_name)) OR (old.alias IS DISTINCT FROM new.alias)) OR (old.first_name IS DISTINCT FROM new.first_name)) OR (old.last_name IS DISTINCT FROM new.last_name)) OR (old.full_name IS DISTINCT FROM new.full_name)) OR (old.display_name_preference IS DISTINCT FROM new.display_name_preference)) OR (old.use_real_name IS DISTINCT FROM new.use_real_name)) OR (old.bio IS DISTINCT FROM new.bio)) OR (old.player_tags IS DISTINCT FROM new.player_tags)) OR (old.login_streak IS DISTINCT FROM new.login_streak)) OR (old.vip_tier IS DISTINCT FROM new.vip_tier)) OR ((old.settings -> 'theme'::text) IS DISTINCT FROM (new.settings -> 'theme'::text))) OR ((old.settings -> 'achievementNotifications'::text) IS DISTINCT FROM (new.settings -> 'achievementNotifications'::text))) OR ((old.settings -> 'settlementAlerts'::text) IS DISTINCT FROM (new.settings -> 'settlementAlerts'::text))) OR (old.diamonds IS DISTINCT FROM new.diamonds))) EXECUTE FUNCTION public.fn_publish_profile_account_change()

triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER profile_appearance_changed AFTER UPDATE OF avatar_url, arena_avatar_url, use_avatar_as_profile_pic, is_vip, vip_expires_at, equipped_frame, equipped_aura ON public.profiles FOR EACH ROW WHEN ((((((((old.avatar_url IS DISTINCT FROM new.avatar_url) OR (old.arena_avatar_url IS DISTINCT FROM new.arena_avatar_url)) OR (old.use_avatar_as_profile_pic IS DISTINCT FROM new.use_avatar_as_profile_pic)) OR (old.is_vip IS DISTINCT FROM new.is_vip)) OR (old.vip_expires_at IS DISTINCT FROM new.vip_expires_at)) OR (old.equipped_frame IS DISTINCT FROM new.equipped_frame)) OR (old.equipped_aura IS DISTINCT FROM new.equipped_aura))) EXECUTE FUNCTION public.fn_publish_profile_appearance_change()

relations.name: sandbox_coach_accuracy
relations.view:
SELECT user_id,
    count(*) AS total_hands,
    sum(
        CASE
            WHEN is_correct THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END) AS correct_count,
    sum(
        CASE
            WHEN (NOT is_correct) THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END) AS incorrect_count,
    round((((sum(
        CASE
            WHEN is_correct THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END))::numeric / (NULLIF(count(*), 0))::numeric) * (100)::numeric), 2) AS accuracy_pct,
    round(avg(
        CASE
            WHEN (NOT is_correct) THEN ev_delta
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END), 2) AS avg_leak_ev
   FROM public.sandbox_coach_results
  GROUP BY user_id;

relations.name: share_streaks
relations.view:
WITH daily_shares AS (
         SELECT share_events.user_id,
            date_trunc('day'::text, (share_events.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text)) AS share_day
           FROM public.share_events
          GROUP BY share_events.user_id, (date_trunc('day'::text, (share_events.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text)))
        ), numbered AS (
         SELECT daily_shares.user_id,
            daily_shares.share_day,
            (daily_shares.share_day - ((row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY daily_shares.user_id ORDER BY daily_shares.share_day))::double precision * '1 day'::interval)) AS grp
           FROM daily_shares
        ), streaks AS (
         SELECT numbered.user_id,
            numbered.grp,
            min(numbered.share_day) AS streak_start,
            max(numbered.share_day) AS streak_end,
            count(*) AS streak_days
           FROM numbered
          GROUP BY numbered.user_id, numbered.grp
        )
 SELECT user_id,
    streak_days,
    streak_start,
    streak_end,
    (streak_end >= (date_trunc('day'::text, (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text)) - '1 day'::interval)) AS is_active
   FROM streaks
  WHERE (streak_days > 1)
  ORDER BY streak_days DESC;
