relations.name: signup_health_view
relations.view:
WITH real_users AS (
         SELECT users.created_at
           FROM auth.users
          WHERE (((users.email)::text !~~ 'probe-%@probe.smarter.poker'::text) AND ((users.email)::text !~~ 'probe-%@probe.smarter.local'::text))
        )
 SELECT ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM real_users
          WHERE (real_users.created_at > (now() - '00:15:00'::interval))) AS new_users_15m,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM real_users
          WHERE (real_users.created_at > (now() - '01:00:00'::interval))) AS new_users_1h,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM real_users
          WHERE (real_users.created_at > (now() - '24:00:00'::interval))) AS new_users_24h,
    ( SELECT max(real_users.created_at) AS max
           FROM real_users) AS last_signup_at,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM public.probe_heartbeats
          WHERE (probe_heartbeats.occurred_at > (now() - '00:15:00'::interval))) AS probe_runs_15m,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM public.probe_heartbeats
          WHERE (probe_heartbeats.occurred_at > (now() - '01:00:00'::interval))) AS probe_runs_1h,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM public.probe_heartbeats
          WHERE ((probe_heartbeats.occurred_at > (now() - '00:15:00'::interval)) AND (probe_heartbeats.status = 'ok'::text))) AS probe_ok_15m,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM public.probe_heartbeats
          WHERE ((probe_heartbeats.occurred_at > (now() - '01:00:00'::interval)) AND (probe_heartbeats.status = 'failed'::text))) AS probe_failed_1h,
    ( SELECT max(probe_heartbeats.occurred_at) AS max
           FROM public.probe_heartbeats) AS last_probe_at,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM public.signup_errors
          WHERE (signup_errors.occurred_at > (now() - '01:00:00'::interval))) AS errors_1h,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM public.signup_errors
          WHERE (signup_errors.occurred_at > (now() - '24:00:00'::interval))) AS errors_24h,
    ( SELECT max(signup_errors.occurred_at) AS max
           FROM public.signup_errors) AS last_error_at;

constraints.name: table_game_scope_is_derived
constraints.definition:
CHECK (((seat_game_scope IS NULL) OR (seat_game_scope =
CASE
    WHEN (cluster_id IS NULL) THEN ('table:'::text || (id)::text)
    ELSE ('cluster:'::text || (cluster_id)::text)
END)))

constraints.name: table_seat_admission_is_derived
constraints.definition:
CHECK (((seat_admission_key IS NULL) OR (seat_admission_key =
CASE
    WHEN ((lower(COALESCE(status, ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['closed'::text, 'completed'::text, 'cancelled'::text, 'finished'::text])) OR (lifecycle = 'closed'::text) OR COALESCE(is_deleted, false) OR COALESCE(is_template, false)) THEN 'closed'::text
    WHEN (tournament_id IS NOT NULL) THEN ('tournament:'::text || (tournament_id)::text)
    ELSE 'cash'::text
END)))

constraints.name: tables_bomb_pot_variant_check

constraints.name: tables_cash_needs_a_game
constraints.definition: CHECK (((tournament_id IS NOT NULL) OR (cluster_id IS NOT NULL) OR (status = ANY (ARRAY['closed'::text, 'deleted'::text])) OR COALESCE(is_deleted, false) OR (club_id IS NULL) OR (game_variant IS NULL) OR (COALESCE(small_blind, (0)::numeric) <= (0)::numeric) OR (COALESCE(big_blind, (0)::numeric) <= COALESCE(small_blind, (0)::numeric)) OR (club_id = '002c2d27-9584-4e52-835a-bb2be148fc81'::uuid)))

constraints.name: tables_dealing_halt_is_explained

constraints.name: tables_name_is_not_a_javascript_accident

constraints.name: tables_rake_cap_bb_range

constraints.name: tables_rake_percent_range
constraints.definition: CHECK (((rake_percent IS NULL) OR (rake_percent = ('-1'::integer)::numeric) OR ((rake_percent >= (0)::numeric) AND (rake_percent <= (100)::numeric)))) NOT VALID

relations.name: tournament_escrow_shadow
relations.view:
SELECT t.id AS tournament_id,
    t.name,
    t.variant,
    t.tournament_type,
    t.status,
    t.club_id,
    t.union_id,
    t.ended_at,
    round(COALESCE(t.prize_pool, (0)::numeric), 2) AS counter_prize_pool,
    round((COALESCE(t.bounty_pool, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(t.bounty_pool_paid, (0)::numeric)), 2) AS counter_bounty_open,
    round(COALESCE(t.total_rake, (0)::numeric), 2) AS counter_total_rake,
    e.prize_in,
    e.bounty_in,
    e.fee_in,
    e.overlay_in,
    e.satellite_in,
    e.prize_out,
    e.bounty_out,
    e.fee_out,
    e.refund_out,
    e.prize_balance,
    e.bounty_balance,
    e.fee_balance,
    round((COALESCE(t.prize_pool, (0)::numeric) - ((e.prize_in + e.overlay_in) + e.satellite_in)), 2) AS counter_prize_gap,
    round(((COALESCE(t.bounty_pool, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(t.bounty_pool_paid, (0)::numeric)) - e.bounty_balance), 2) AS counter_bounty_gap,
    round((COALESCE(t.total_rake, (0)::numeric) - e.fee_in), 2) AS counter_fee_gap
   FROM (public.tournaments t
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL public.fn_ca_tournament_escrow_chips(t.id) e(prize_in, bounty_in, fee_in, overlay_in, satellite_in, prize_out, bounty_out, fee_out, refund_out, prize_balance, bounty_balance, fee_balance))
  WHERE (COALESCE(t.ended_at, t.updated_at, t.created_at) > (now() - '7 days'::interval));

relations.name: tours_due_for_refresh
relations.view:
SELECT tour_code,
    tour_name,
    tour_type,
    schedule_url,
    scrape_method,
    last_checked_at,
    next_check_at,
    refresh_interval_days,
    (EXTRACT(epoch FROM (now() - COALESCE(last_checked_at, '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone))) / (86400)::numeric) AS days_since_check,
    scrape_status,
    error_count
   FROM public.tour_source_registry
  WHERE ((is_active = true) AND (scrape_status <> 'defunct'::text) AND (scrape_method <> 'manual'::text) AND ((next_check_at IS NULL) OR (next_check_at <= now())))
  ORDER BY next_check_at NULLS FIRST, last_checked_at NULLS FIRST;

constraints.name: training_verified_leaderboard_dimension_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((dimension_type = 'overall'::text) AND (dimension_key = 'overall'::text) AND (game_id IS NULL) AND (category IS NULL)) OR ((dimension_type = 'game'::text) AND (dimension_key = game_id) AND ((char_length(game_id) >= 1) AND (char_length(game_id) <= 100)) AND (category IS NULL)) OR ((dimension_type = 'category'::text) AND (dimension_key = category) AND (game_id IS NULL) AND (category = ANY (ARRAY['mtt'::text, 'cash'::text, 'spins'::text, 'psychology'::text, 'advanced'::text])))))

constraints.name: training_verified_leaderboard_score_samples_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((gtow_score_samples >= 0) AND (gtow_score_samples <= sessions_completed)) AND (((gtow_score_samples = 0) AND (gtow_score_avg IS NULL) AND (gtow_score_sum = (0)::numeric)) OR ((gtow_score_samples > 0) AND (gtow_score_avg IS NOT NULL)))))

constraints.name: training_verified_leaderboard_totals_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((sessions_completed >= 0) AND (questions_answered >= 0) AND ((questions_correct >= 0) AND (questions_correct <= questions_answered)) AND ((accuracy >= (0)::numeric) AND (accuracy <= (100)::numeric)) AND ((perfect_rounds >= 0) AND (perfect_rounds <= sessions_completed)) AND (best_streak >= 0) AND (score_scale = 2)))

relations.view:
SELECT a.account_code,
    a.kind,
    a.user_id,
    a.subject_id,
    a.state,
    a.tracks_balance,
    a.min_balance,
    a.balance AS cached_balance,
    COALESCE(l.total, (0)::numeric) AS journal_balance,
    COALESCE(l.n, (0)::bigint) AS line_count,
        CASE
            WHEN a.tracks_balance THEN ((a.balance)::numeric - COALESCE(l.total, (0)::numeric))
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END AS drift
   FROM (public.trivia_ledger_accounts a
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT trivia_ledger_lines.account_code,
            sum(trivia_ledger_lines.amount) AS total,
            count(*) AS n
           FROM public.trivia_ledger_lines
          GROUP BY trivia_ledger_lines.account_code) l ON ((l.account_code = a.account_code)));

relations.name: trivia_ledger_recon_date
relations.view:
SELECT ((l.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago'::text))::date AS chicago_date,
    count(DISTINCT l.journal_id) AS journals,
    count(*) AS lines,
    sum(l.amount) AS imbalance,
    COALESCE(sum((- l.amount)) FILTER (WHERE ((l.account_kind = 'player_wallet'::text) AND (l.amount < 0))), (0)::numeric) AS wallet_debits,
    COALESCE(sum(l.amount) FILTER (WHERE ((l.account_kind = 'player_wallet'::text) AND (l.amount > 0))), (0)::numeric) AS wallet_credits,
    COALESCE(sum(l.amount) FILTER (WHERE (l.account_kind = 'player_wallet'::text)), (0)::numeric) AS wallet_net,
    COALESCE(sum(COALESCE(d.amount, ar.amount)) FILTER (WHERE (l.account_kind = 'player_wallet'::text)), (0)::bigint) AS platform_net,
    (COALESCE(sum(l.amount) FILTER (WHERE (l.account_kind = 'player_wallet'::text)), (0)::numeric) - (COALESCE(sum(COALESCE(d.amount, ar.amount)) FILTER (WHERE (l.account_kind = 'player_wallet'::text)), (0)::bigint))::numeric) AS unexplained_variance
   FROM ((public.trivia_ledger_lines l
     LEFT JOIN public.diamond_transactions d ON ((d.id = l.diamond_transaction_id)))
     LEFT JOIN public.ca_diamond_journal_archive ar ON ((ar.id = l.diamond_transaction_id)))
  GROUP BY (((l.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago'::text))::date);

relations.name: trivia_ledger_recon_reference
relations.view:
SELECT 'journal'::text AS origin,
    j.id AS journal_id,
    j.idempotency_key,
    j.operation,
    l.line_no,
    l.user_id,
    l.wallet_reference AS reference,
    l.wallet_kind AS kind,
    l.amount,
    l.diamond_transaction_id,
    (COALESCE(d.amount, ar.amount))::bigint AS platform_amount,
    COALESCE(d.created_at, ar.created_at, l.created_at) AS created_at,
        CASE
            WHEN ((d.id IS NULL) AND (ar.id IS NULL)) THEN 'missing_platform_row'::text
            WHEN (COALESCE(d.user_id, ar.user_id) IS DISTINCT FROM l.user_id) THEN 'user_mismatch'::text
            WHEN ((COALESCE(d.amount, ar.amount))::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM l.amount) THEN 'amount_mismatch'::text
            WHEN (COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(d.transaction_type, ar.transaction_type)), ''::text), d.type, ar.type) IS DISTINCT FROM l.wallet_kind) THEN 'kind_mismatch'::text
            WHEN ((l.reconciliation_state = 'linked'::text) AND (COALESCE(d.reference_id, ar.reference_id) IS DISTINCT FROM l.wallet_reference)) THEN 'reference_mismatch'::text
            WHEN (d.id IS NULL) THEN 'reconciled_archived'::text
            ELSE 'reconciled'::text
        END AS state
   FROM (((public.trivia_ledger_lines l
     JOIN public.trivia_ledger_journals j ON ((j.id = l.journal_id)))
     LEFT JOIN public.diamond_transactions d ON ((d.id = l.diamond_transaction_id)))
     LEFT JOIN public.ca_diamond_journal_archive ar ON ((ar.id = l.diamond_transaction_id)))
  WHERE (l.account_kind = 'player_wallet'::text)
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'platform'::text AS origin,
    NULL::uuid AS journal_id,
    NULL::text AS idempotency_key,
    NULL::text AS operation,
    NULL::integer AS line_no,
    d.user_id,
    d.reference_id AS reference,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(d.transaction_type), ''::text), d.type) AS kind,
    (d.amount)::bigint AS amount,
    d.id AS diamond_transaction_id,
    (d.amount)::bigint AS platform_amount,
    d.created_at,
        CASE
            WHEN (d.created_at < public.trivia_ledger_epoch()) THEN 'legacy_pending_backfill'::text
            WHEN ((public.trivia_ledger_platform_family(COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(d.transaction_type), ''::text), d.type), d.reference_id) = 'solo'::text) AND (NOT public.trivia_ledger_switch_at('solo_journal'::text, d.created_at))) THEN 'legacy_path_switch_off'::text
            ELSE 'unjournaled_unexplained'::text
        END AS state
   FROM public.diamond_transactions d
  WHERE ((public.trivia_ledger_platform_family(COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(d.transaction_type), ''::text), d.type), d.reference_id) IS NOT NULL) AND (d.amount <> 0) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM public.trivia_ledger_lines l
          WHERE (l.diamond_transaction_id = d.id)))));

relations.name: trivia_ledger_recon_settlement
relations.view:
SELECT s.id AS settlement_id,
    s.subject_type,
    s.subject_id,
    s.state,
    s.outcome,
    s.rules_version_id,
    s.idempotency_key,
    s.gross_pool,
    s.held_total,
    s.subsidy_total,
    s.released_total,
    s.refunded_total,
    s.rake_amount,
    s.final_prize_pool,
    s.paid_total,
    a.balance AS escrow_cached_balance,
    COALESCE(jl.total, (0)::numeric) AS escrow_journal_balance,
    a.state AS escrow_state,
    (s.state = ANY (ARRAY['settled'::text, 'refunded'::text, 'voided'::text])) AS terminal,
    ((((s.held_total - s.released_total) - s.refunded_total) - s.rake_amount) - s.paid_total) AS expected_escrow,
    ((((((s.held_total - s.released_total) - s.refunded_total) - s.rake_amount) - s.paid_total))::numeric - COALESCE(jl.total, (0)::numeric)) AS unexplained_variance,
    ((s.state = ANY (ARRAY['settled'::text, 'refunded'::text, 'voided'::text])) AND ((a.balance <> 0) OR (a.state <> 'closed'::text) OR (COALESCE(jl.total, (0)::numeric) <> (0)::numeric))) AS nonzero_terminal_escrow,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM public.trivia_settlement_participants p
          WHERE (p.settlement_id = s.id)) AS participants,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM public.trivia_settlement_participants p
          WHERE ((p.settlement_id = s.id) AND (p.participant_kind = 'horse'::text))) AS horse_participants,
    s.opened_at,
    s.locked_at,
    s.terminal_at,
    EXTRACT(epoch FROM (s.terminal_at - s.locked_at)) AS settlement_seconds
   FROM ((public.trivia_settlements s
     JOIN public.trivia_ledger_accounts a ON ((a.account_code = s.escrow_account_code)))
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT trivia_ledger_lines.account_code,
            sum(trivia_ledger_lines.amount) AS total
           FROM public.trivia_ledger_lines
          GROUP BY trivia_ledger_lines.account_code) jl ON ((jl.account_code = s.escrow_account_code)));

relations.name: trivia_ledger_recon_treasury
relations.view:
SELECT a.balance AS treasury_balance,
    COALESCE(jl.total, (0)::numeric) AS journal_balance,
    ((a.balance)::numeric - COALESCE(jl.total, (0)::numeric)) AS drift,
    public.trivia_ledger_config_value('treasury_floor'::text) AS floor,
    public.trivia_ledger_config_value('treasury_warning_level'::text) AS warning_level,
    public.trivia_ledger_config_value('treasury_daily_subsidy_ceiling'::text) AS daily_ceiling,
    public.trivia_ledger_config_value('treasury_exposure_ceiling'::text) AS exposure_ceiling,
    COALESCE(( SELECT sum((- l.amount)) AS sum
           FROM public.trivia_ledger_lines l
          WHERE ((l.account_code = 'treasury:trivia'::text) AND (l.amount < 0) AND (l.created_at >= (date_trunc('day'::text, (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago'::text)) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago'::text)))), (0)::numeric) AS outflow_today,
    COALESCE(( SELECT sum(p.entry_amount) AS sum
           FROM (public.trivia_settlement_participants p
             JOIN public.trivia_settlements s ON ((s.id = p.settlement_id)))
          WHERE ((p.funding_source = 'treasury'::text) AND (p.state = 'held'::text) AND (s.state = ANY (ARRAY['open'::text, 'locked'::text])))), (0)::numeric) AS open_exposure,
    COALESCE(( SELECT sum(l.amount) AS sum
           FROM (public.trivia_ledger_lines l
             JOIN public.trivia_ledger_journals j ON ((j.id = l.journal_id)))
          WHERE ((l.account_code = 'treasury:trivia'::text) AND (j.operation = 'treasury_fund'::text))), (0)::numeric) AS lifetime_funded,
    COALESCE(( SELECT sum((- l.amount)) AS sum
           FROM public.trivia_ledger_lines l
          WHERE ((l.account_code = 'treasury:trivia'::text) AND (l.amount < 0))), (0)::numeric) AS lifetime_outflow,
    COALESCE(( SELECT sum(l.amount) AS sum
           FROM (public.trivia_ledger_lines l
             JOIN public.trivia_ledger_journals j ON ((j.id = l.journal_id)))
          WHERE ((l.account_code = 'treasury:trivia'::text) AND (l.amount > 0) AND (j.operation <> 'treasury_fund'::text))), (0)::numeric) AS lifetime_returned
   FROM ((( SELECT 1 AS "?column?") one
     LEFT JOIN public.trivia_ledger_accounts a ON ((a.account_code = 'treasury:trivia'::text)))
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sum(trivia_ledger_lines.amount) AS total
           FROM public.trivia_ledger_lines
          WHERE (trivia_ledger_lines.account_code = 'treasury:trivia'::text)) jl ON (true));

relations.name: trivia_ledger_recon_user
relations.view:
SELECT l.user_id,
    count(*) AS wallet_lines,
    sum(l.amount) AS journal_net,
    sum(COALESCE(d.amount, ar.amount, 0)) AS platform_net,
    (sum(l.amount) - (sum(COALESCE(d.amount, ar.amount, 0)))::numeric) AS unexplained_variance,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE ((d.id IS NULL) AND (ar.id IS NULL))) AS missing_platform_rows,
    COALESCE(( SELECT sum(la.balance) AS sum
           FROM public.trivia_ledger_accounts la
          WHERE ((la.kind = 'refund_liability'::text) AND (la.user_id = l.user_id))), (0)::numeric) AS owed_liability
   FROM ((public.trivia_ledger_lines l
     LEFT JOIN public.diamond_transactions d ON ((d.id = l.diamond_transaction_id)))
     LEFT JOIN public.ca_diamond_journal_archive ar ON ((ar.id = l.diamond_transaction_id)))
  WHERE (l.account_kind = 'player_wallet'::text)
  GROUP BY l.user_id;

relations.name: trivia_question_eligibility_v1
relations.view:
WITH pol AS (
         SELECT trivia_eligibility_policies.policy_version,
            trivia_eligibility_policies.quality_threshold,
            trivia_eligibility_policies.supported_content_versions,
            trivia_eligibility_policies.unsupported_sources,
            trivia_eligibility_policies.max_review_age_days,
            trivia_eligibility_policies.report_quarantine_threshold,
            trivia_eligibility_policies.provisional,
            trivia_eligibility_policies.decided_by,
            trivia_eligibility_policies.decided_at,
            trivia_eligibility_policies.note
           FROM public.trivia_eligibility_policies
          ORDER BY trivia_eligibility_policies.policy_version DESC
         LIMIT 1
        ), rep AS (
         SELECT c_1.canonical_question_id,
            (count(DISTINCT r.user_id))::integer AS n
           FROM (public.trivia_question_reports r
             JOIN public.trivia_question_curation c_1 ON ((c_1.question_id = r.question_id)))
          WHERE ((r.state = ANY (ARRAY['open'::text, 'triaged'::text])) AND r.valid)
          GROUP BY c_1.canonical_question_id
        ), quar AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT trivia_question_quarantine.question_id
           FROM public.trivia_question_quarantine
          WHERE (trivia_question_quarantine.released_at IS NULL)
        )
 SELECT q.id AS question_id,
    c.current_revision_id AS revision_id,
    c.canonical_question_id,
    c.fingerprint,
    q.category,
    q.difficulty,
    q.quality_score,
    q.audit_verified,
    COALESCE(rv.structurally_valid, false) AS structurally_valid,
    rv.content_version,
    rv.min_timer_seconds,
    COALESCE(c.modes, '{}'::text[]) AS modes,
    ((c.question_id IS NOT NULL) AND (q.id = c.canonical_question_id)) AS is_canonical,
    (quar.question_id IS NOT NULL) AS quarantined,
    COALESCE(rep.n, 0) AS open_valid_reports,
    c.last_reviewed_at,
        CASE
            WHEN (c.last_reviewed_at IS NULL) THEN NULL::integer
            ELSE (floor((EXTRACT(epoch FROM (now() - c.last_reviewed_at)) / (86400)::numeric)))::integer
        END AS review_age_days,
    q.source,
    pol.policy_version,
    array_remove(ARRAY[
        CASE
            WHEN ((c.question_id IS NULL) OR (rv.id IS NULL)) THEN 'no_revision'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN ((rv.id IS NOT NULL) AND (NOT rv.structurally_valid)) THEN 'invalid_structure'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN (q.audit_verified IS NULL) THEN 'audit_unset'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN (q.audit_verified IS FALSE) THEN 'audit_failed'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(q.quality_score, '-1'::integer) < pol.quality_threshold) THEN 'low_quality'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN ((rv.id IS NOT NULL) AND (NOT (rv.content_version = ANY (pol.supported_content_versions)))) THEN 'unsupported_rules_version'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN ((q.source IS NOT NULL) AND (q.source = ANY (pol.unsupported_sources))) THEN 'unsupported_source'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN ((c.question_id IS NOT NULL) AND (q.id <> c.canonical_question_id)) THEN 'duplicate_alias'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN (quar.question_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'quarantined'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(rep.n, 0) > 0) THEN 'open_report'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN ((c.question_id IS NOT NULL) AND (cardinality(c.modes) = 0)) THEN 'no_mode'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN ((pol.max_review_age_days IS NOT NULL) AND ((c.last_reviewed_at IS NULL) OR (c.last_reviewed_at < (now() - make_interval(days => pol.max_review_age_days))))) THEN 'review_stale'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END], NULL::text) AS reject_reasons
   FROM (((((public.trivia_questions q
     CROSS JOIN pol)
     LEFT JOIN public.trivia_question_curation c ON ((c.question_id = q.id)))
     LEFT JOIN public.trivia_question_revisions rv ON ((rv.id = c.current_revision_id)))
     LEFT JOIN rep ON ((rep.canonical_question_id = c.canonical_question_id)))
     LEFT JOIN quar ON ((quar.question_id = q.id)));

relations.name: trivia_question_player_stats
relations.view:
SELECT id,
    category,
    difficulty,
    times_shown,
    times_correct,
    skipped_count,
        CASE
            WHEN (times_shown >= 30) THEN round((((times_correct)::numeric / (times_shown)::numeric) * (100)::numeric), 1)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS success_rate_pct,
        CASE
            WHEN ((times_shown >= 30) AND (difficulty = 'easy'::text) AND (((times_correct)::numeric / (times_shown)::numeric) < 0.40)) THEN 'too-hard-or-wrong'::text
            WHEN ((times_shown >= 30) AND (difficulty = 'hard'::text) AND (((times_correct)::numeric / (times_shown)::numeric) > 0.95)) THEN 'mislabeled-easy'::text
            WHEN ((times_shown >= 30) AND (difficulty = 'medium'::text) AND (((times_correct)::numeric / (times_shown)::numeric) < 0.30)) THEN 'suspect-bad'::text
            WHEN ((times_shown >= 30) AND (((skipped_count)::numeric / (times_shown)::numeric) > 0.20)) THEN 'high-skip'::text
            ELSE 'ok'::text
        END AS player_signal,
    quality_score
   FROM public.trivia_questions;

relations.name: trivia_question_pool_stats
relations.view:
SELECT category,
    count(*) AS total_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (difficulty = 'easy'::text)) AS easy_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (difficulty = 'medium'::text)) AS medium_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (difficulty = 'hard'::text)) AS hard_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (last_used_at IS NULL)) AS never_used,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (last_used_at > (now() - '60 days'::interval))) AS used_recently,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE ((last_used_at IS NULL) OR (last_used_at <= (now() - '60 days'::interval)))) AS available_now
   FROM public.trivia_questions
  GROUP BY category
  ORDER BY category;

relations.name: trivia_review_queue_v1
relations.view:
SELECT question_id,
    revision_id,
    category,
    difficulty,
    quality_score,
    created_at,
    priority,
    inconclusive_attempts
   FROM ( SELECT q.id AS question_id,
            c.current_revision_id AS revision_id,
            q.category,
            q.difficulty,
            q.quality_score,
            q.created_at,
                CASE
                    WHEN (q.quality_score >= 7) THEN 1
                    ELSE 2
                END AS priority,
            ( SELECT (count(*))::integer AS count
                   FROM public.trivia_question_reviews rv
                  WHERE ((rv.revision_id = c.current_revision_id) AND (rv.verdict = 'inconclusive'::text))) AS inconclusive_attempts
           FROM ((public.trivia_questions q
             JOIN public.trivia_question_curation c ON ((c.question_id = q.id)))
             JOIN public.trivia_question_revisions r ON ((r.id = c.current_revision_id)))
          WHERE ((q.audit_verified IS NULL) AND (COALESCE(q.quality_score, 0) >= 6) AND (c.canonical_question_id = q.id) AND r.structurally_valid AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM public.trivia_question_quarantine z
                  WHERE ((z.question_id = q.id) AND (z.released_at IS NULL))))))) x
  WHERE (inconclusive_attempts < 3);

relations.name: trivia_tournament_metrics_v1
relations.view:
SELECT t.id AS tournament_id,
    t.schedule_kind,
    t.scheduled_local_date,
    t.start_time,
    t.lifecycle_state,
    t.terminal_reason,
    t.horse_target,
    t.horse_population_mode,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM public.trivia_tournament_entrants e
          WHERE ((e.tournament_id = t.id) AND (e.participant_kind = 'horse'::text) AND (e.entry_state = 'entered'::text))) AS horses_entered,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM public.trivia_tournament_entrants e
          WHERE ((e.tournament_id = t.id) AND (e.participant_kind = 'human'::text) AND (e.entry_state = 'entered'::text))) AS humans_entered,
    ( SELECT pr.outcome
           FROM public.trivia_tournament_population_runs pr
          WHERE ((pr.tournament_id = t.id) AND (pr.run_kind = 'final_reconcile'::text))) AS population_outcome,
    EXTRACT(epoch FROM (t.live_started_at - t.start_time)) AS start_delay_seconds,
    EXTRACT(epoch FROM (t.settled_at - t.final_resolved_at)) AS settlement_latency_seconds,
    EXTRACT(epoch FROM (t.final_resolved_at - t.live_started_at)) AS event_duration_seconds,
    ( SELECT max(EXTRACT(epoch FROM (r.closed_at - r.opens_at))) AS max
           FROM public.trivia_tournament_bracket_rounds r
          WHERE (r.tournament_id = t.id)) AS max_round_seconds,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM public.trivia_tournament_seats s
          WHERE ((s.tournament_id = t.id) AND (s.status = 'no_show'::text))) AS no_shows,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM public.trivia_tournament_bracket_rounds r
          WHERE ((r.tournament_id = t.id) AND (r.status = 'open'::text) AND (r.deadline_at < (clock_timestamp() - '00:02:00'::interval)))) AS stuck_rounds,
    fs.gross_entry_total,
    fs.horse_funding_total,
    ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(res.payout), (0)::bigint) AS "coalesce"
           FROM public.trivia_tournament_results res
          WHERE ((res.tournament_id = t.id) AND (res.participant_kind = 'human'::text))) AS human_payout_total,
    ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(res.payout), (0)::bigint) AS "coalesce"
           FROM public.trivia_tournament_results res
          WHERE ((res.tournament_id = t.id) AND (res.participant_kind = 'horse'::text))) AS horse_payout_total,
    st.state AS settlement_state,
    ( SELECT a.balance
           FROM public.trivia_ledger_accounts a
          WHERE (a.account_code = ('escrow:tournament:'::text || (t.id)::text))) AS escrow_balance
   FROM ((public.trivia_tournaments t
     LEFT JOIN public.trivia_tournament_field_snapshots fs ON ((fs.tournament_id = t.id)))
     LEFT JOIN public.trivia_settlements st ON (((st.subject_type = 'tournament'::text) AND (st.subject_id = t.id))))
  WHERE (t.engine_version IS NOT NULL);

relations.name: unified_events_calendar
relations.view:
SELECT 'daily'::text AS source,
    (vdt.id)::text AS native_id,
    vdt.venue_name,
    (vdt.venue_id)::text AS venue_id,
    NULL::text AS series_id,
    NULL::text AS tour_event_id,
    NULL::text AS tour_code,
    vdt.tournament_name AS event_name,
    vdt.start_time,
    (vdt.buy_in)::numeric AS buy_in,
    vdt.game_type,
    (vdt.guaranteed)::numeric AS guaranteed,
    vdt.format,
    (vdt.starting_stack)::text AS starting_stack,
    vdt.day_of_week,
    (vdt.event_date)::text AS specific_date,
    vdt.is_recurring,
    vdt.is_suppressed,
    vdt.is_active,
    v.city,
    v.state,
    (v.latitude)::numeric AS latitude,
    (v.longitude)::numeric AS longitude,
    NULL::text AS logo_url
   FROM (public.venue_daily_tournaments vdt
     LEFT JOIN public.poker_venues v ON ((v.id = vdt.venue_id)))
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'series'::text AS source,
    (ps.id)::text AS native_id,
    ps.venue_name,
    (ps.venue_id)::text AS venue_id,
    (ps.id)::text AS series_id,
    NULL::text AS tour_event_id,
    ps.tour_code,
    COALESCE(ps.series_name, ps.short_name) AS event_name,
    NULL::text AS start_time,
    (COALESCE(ps.main_event_buyin, ps.buy_in_min))::numeric AS buy_in,
    COALESCE(ps.series_type, 'NLH'::text) AS game_type,
    (COALESCE(ps.total_guaranteed, ps.main_event_guaranteed))::numeric AS guaranteed,
    NULL::text AS format,
    NULL::text AS starting_stack,
    NULL::text AS day_of_week,
    (ps.start_date)::text AS specific_date,
    false AS is_recurring,
    ps.is_suppressed,
    true AS is_active,
    COALESCE(ps.city, v.city) AS city,
    COALESCE(ps.state, v.state) AS state,
    (v.latitude)::numeric AS latitude,
    (v.longitude)::numeric AS longitude,
    ps.logo_url
   FROM (public.poker_series ps
     LEFT JOIN public.poker_venues v ON ((v.id = ps.venue_id)))
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'tour'::text AS source,
    (tse.id)::text AS native_id,
    tse.stop_venue AS venue_name,
    NULL::text AS venue_id,
    NULL::text AS series_id,
    (tse.id)::text AS tour_event_id,
    tse.tour_code,
    COALESCE(tse.event_name, tse.stop_name) AS event_name,
    tse.start_time,
    (tse.buy_in)::numeric AS buy_in,
    tse.game_type,
    (tse.guarantee)::numeric AS guaranteed,
    NULL::text AS format,
    NULL::text AS starting_stack,
    NULL::text AS day_of_week,
    (tse.start_date)::text AS specific_date,
    false AS is_recurring,
    false AS is_suppressed,
    true AS is_active,
    tse.stop_city AS city,
    tse.stop_state AS state,
    NULL::numeric AS latitude,
    NULL::numeric AS longitude,
    NULL::text AS logo_url
   FROM public.tour_stop_events tse;

    union_pnl_inventory_checkpoint_issues.event_id

relations.name: v_agent_commissions
relations.view:
SELECT ac.id,
    ac.club_id,
    ac.user_id,
    ac.amount,
    ac.commission_rate,
    ac.source_type,
    ac.source_id,
    ac.notes,
    ac.created_at,
    COALESCE(ac.settled_at, s.paid_at) AS settled_at,
        CASE
            WHEN (ac.settled_at IS NOT NULL) THEN 'claim'::text
            WHEN (s.id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'round2'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS settled_via,
    s.id AS settlement_id
   FROM (public.agent_commissions ac
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT x.id,
            x.paid_at
           FROM public.agent_commission_settlements x
          WHERE ((x.club_id = ac.club_id) AND (x.user_id = ac.user_id) AND (ac.created_at >= x.period_start) AND (ac.created_at < x.period_end))
         LIMIT 1) s ON (true));

relations.name: v_bomb_pot_daily
relations.view:
SELECT date_trunc('day'::text, created_at) AS day,
    (bomb_pot ->> 'trigger_reason'::text) AS trigger_reason,
    ((bomb_pot ->> 'board_count'::text))::integer AS board_count,
    (bomb_pot ->> 'variant'::text) AS variant,
    count(*) AS hands,
    round(avg((pot_size)::numeric), 2) AS avg_pot,
    round(sum((rake_amount)::numeric), 2) AS total_rake,
    round(avg(((bomb_pot ->> 'ante_amount'::text))::numeric), 2) AS avg_ante
   FROM public.hand_history
  WHERE ((bomb_pot IS NOT NULL) AND (created_at > (now() - '30 days'::interval)))
  GROUP BY (date_trunc('day'::text, created_at)), (bomb_pot ->> 'trigger_reason'::text), ((bomb_pot ->> 'board_count'::text))::integer, (bomb_pot ->> 'variant'::text);

relations.name: v_bomb_pot_outcomes
relations.view:
SELECT day,
    count(*) AS multi_board_hands,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (distinct_winners = 1)) AS full_scoops,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (distinct_winners > 1)) AS split_hands,
    round(avg(award_units), 2) AS avg_award_units
   FROM ( SELECT bomb_pot_award_units.hand_history_id,
            date_trunc('day'::text, min(bomb_pot_award_units.created_at)) AS day,
            count(DISTINCT bomb_pot_award_units.user_id) AS distinct_winners,
            count(*) AS award_units
           FROM public.bomb_pot_award_units
          WHERE (bomb_pot_award_units.created_at > (now() - '90 days'::interval))
          GROUP BY bomb_pot_award_units.hand_history_id) per_hand
  GROUP BY day;

relations.name: v_bomb_pot_vs_normal
relations.view:
SELECT date_trunc('day'::text, created_at) AS day,
    (bomb_pot IS NOT NULL) AS is_bomb,
    count(*) AS hands,
    round(avg((pot_size)::numeric), 2) AS avg_pot
   FROM public.hand_history
  WHERE (created_at > (now() - '7 days'::interval))
  GROUP BY (date_trunc('day'::text, created_at)), (bomb_pot IS NOT NULL);

relations.name: v_ca_alert_board
relations.view:
SELECT r.source,
    r.owner,
    r.status,
    r.sla_hours,
    r.auto_resolve_hours,
    count(i.id) FILTER (WHERE (i.status = ANY (ARRAY['open'::text, 'acknowledged'::text, 'reconciling'::text]))) AS open,
    min(i.detected_at) FILTER (WHERE (i.status = ANY (ARRAY['open'::text, 'acknowledged'::text, 'reconciling'::text]))) AS oldest_open_at,
    count(i.id) FILTER (WHERE ((i.status = ANY (ARRAY['open'::text, 'acknowledged'::text, 'reconciling'::text])) AND (i.detected_at < (now() - make_interval(hours => r.sla_hours))))) AS past_sla,
    max(i.detected_at) AS last_detected_at,
    count(i.id) FILTER (WHERE (i.detected_at > (now() - '24:00:00'::interval))) AS filed_24h,
    r.note
   FROM (public.ca_detector_registry r
     LEFT JOIN public.ca_drift_incidents i ON ((i.source = r.source)))
  GROUP BY r.source, r.owner, r.status, r.sla_hours, r.auto_resolve_hours, r.note;

relations.name: v_ca_chip_balance_writers
relations.view:
WITH f AS (
         SELECT p.proname,
            p.prosrc AS s,
            p.prosecdef
           FROM (pg_proc p
             JOIN pg_namespace n ON ((n.oid = p.pronamespace)))
          WHERE ((n.nspname = ANY (ARRAY['public'::name, 'smarter_private'::name])) AND (p.prokind = 'f'::"char"))
        ), w AS (
         SELECT f.proname,
            f.prosecdef,
            array_remove(ARRAY[
                CASE
                    WHEN ((f.s ~* 'update\s+(public\.)?club_members\M'::text) AND (f.s ~* '\mchip_balance\M'::text)) THEN 'player_wallet'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((f.s ~* '(update|delete\s+from)\s+(public\.)?table_seats\M'::text) AND (f.s ~* '\mstack\M'::text)) THEN 'table_stack'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN (f.s ~* '(insert\s+into|update)\s+(public\.)?table_pending_addons\M'::text) THEN 'table_stack'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((f.s ~* 'update\s+(public\.)?clubs\M'::text) AND (f.s ~* '\m(chip_treasury|chip_pool)\M'::text)) THEN 'club_treasury'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN (f.s ~* '(update|insert\s+into)\s+(public\.)?union_wallets\M'::text) THEN 'union_wallet'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN (f.s ~* '(update|insert\s+into)\s+(public\.)?bbj_pools\M'::text) THEN 'bbj_pool'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((f.s ~* 'update\s+(public\.)?club_wallets\M'::text) AND (f.s ~* '\mchip_balance\M'::text)) THEN 'club_wallet (uncovered)'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((f.s ~* 'update\s+(public\.)?agents\M'::text) AND (f.s ~* '\mwallet_balance\M'::text)) THEN 'agent_wallet (uncovered)'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN (f.s ~* '(update|insert\s+into)\s+(public\.)?spin_bonus_pools\M'::text) THEN 'spin_reserve (uncovered)'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN (f.s ~* '(update|insert\s+into)\s+(public\.)?tournament_escrow\M'::text) THEN 'prize_liability (uncovered)'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN ((f.s ~* 'update\s+(public\.)?(club_members|clubs)\M'::text) AND (f.s ~* '\mpromo_balance\M'::text)) THEN 'promo_wallet (uncovered)'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END], NULL::text) AS stores,
            (f.s ~* 'ledger_autoskip_'::text) AS stands_down,
            (f.s ~* 'insert\s+into\s+(public\.)?chip_ledger\M'::text) AS writes_own_leg,
            (f.s ~* '\m(fn_ca_post_leg|fn_credit_and_log|log_wallet_transaction|atomic_credit_wallet_and_log|atomic_deduct_wallet_and_log|atomic_distribute_rake|fn_ca_post_correction)\M'::text) AS calls_a_door
           FROM f
        )
 SELECT proname,
    prosecdef,
    stores,
    stands_down,
    writes_own_leg,
    calls_a_door,
        CASE
            WHEN (cardinality(stores) = 0) THEN 'journal writer only'::text
            WHEN (NOT (stores && ARRAY['player_wallet'::text, 'table_stack'::text, 'club_treasury'::text, 'union_wallet'::text, 'bbj_pool'::text])) THEN 'uncovered store (next migration)'::text
            WHEN stands_down THEN 'stand-down: writes its own leg; the promise is verified at commit'::text
            WHEN ((stores @> ARRAY['table_stack'::text]) AND (NOT (stores && ARRAY['player_wallet'::text, 'club_treasury'::text, 'union_wallet'::text, 'bbj_pool'::text]))) THEN 'felt writer: no journal trigger; the felt account is checked at commit'::text
            ELSE 'ledger-atomic: the autoledger writes the leg; checked at commit'::text
        END AS class
   FROM w
  WHERE ((cardinality(stores) > 0) OR writes_own_leg);

relations.name: v_openclaw_job_staleness
relations.view:
WITH s AS MATERIALIZED (
         SELECT cel.job_name,
            cel.started_at,
            lag(cel.started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY cel.job_name ORDER BY cel.started_at) AS prev_started_at
           FROM public.cron_execution_log cel
          WHERE ((cel.started_at > (now() - '30 days'::interval)) AND (cel.status = 'success'::text) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM public.ca_retired_cron_jobs r
                  WHERE (r.job_name = cel.job_name)))))
        ), g AS (
         SELECT s.job_name,
            (EXTRACT(epoch FROM (s.started_at - s.prev_started_at)) / 60.0) AS gap_minutes
           FROM s
          WHERE (s.prev_started_at IS NOT NULL)
        ), p AS MATERIALIZED (
         SELECT g.job_name,
            percentile_cont((0.9)::double precision) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ((g.gap_minutes)::double precision)) AS p90_gap_minutes
           FROM g
          GROUP BY g.job_name
        ), fired AS MATERIALIZED (
         SELECT cel.job_name,
            min(cel.started_at) AS first_seen_at,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE (cel.started_at > (now() - '10 days'::interval))) AS fires_10d
           FROM public.cron_execution_log cel
          WHERE ((cel.started_at > (now() - '30 days'::interval)) AND (cel.status <> 'running'::text) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM public.ca_retired_cron_jobs r
                  WHERE (r.job_name = cel.job_name)))))
          GROUP BY cel.job_name
        ), agg AS MATERIALIZED (
         SELECT f.job_name,
            COALESCE(a30.last_success_at, ( SELECT max(c.started_at) AS max
                   FROM public.cron_execution_log c
                  WHERE ((c.job_name = f.job_name) AND (c.status = 'success'::text)))) AS last_success_at,
            COALESCE(a30.successes_30d, (0)::bigint) AS successes_30d,
            f.first_seen_at,
            f.fires_10d
           FROM (fired f
             LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.job_name,
                    max(s.started_at) AS last_success_at,
                    count(*) AS successes_30d
                   FROM s
                  GROUP BY s.job_name) a30 ON ((a30.job_name = f.job_name)))
        ), m AS (
         SELECT agg.job_name,
            agg.last_success_at,
            agg.successes_30d,
            agg.fires_10d,
            (EXTRACT(epoch FROM (now() - COALESCE(agg.last_success_at, agg.first_seen_at))) / 60.0) AS silent_minutes
           FROM agg
        )
 SELECT m.job_name,
    m.last_success_at,
    m.successes_30d,
    round(m.silent_minutes, 2) AS silent_minutes,
    round((p.p90_gap_minutes)::numeric, 2) AS p90_gap_minutes,
    round((
        CASE
            WHEN (m.successes_30d >= 5) THEN LEAST(GREATEST(((2)::double precision * p.p90_gap_minutes), (45)::double precision), (14400)::double precision)
            ELSE (14400)::double precision
        END)::numeric, 2) AS threshold_minutes,
    (((m.successes_30d >= 5) AND ((m.silent_minutes)::double precision > LEAST(GREATEST(((2)::double precision * p.p90_gap_minutes), (45)::double precision), (14400)::double precision))) OR ((m.silent_minutes > (14400)::numeric) AND ((m.successes_30d > 0) OR (m.fires_10d >= 2)))) AS is_stale
   FROM (m
     LEFT JOIN p ON ((p.job_name = m.job_name)));

relations.name: v_spin_draw_booking_gaps
relations.view:
WITH draw AS (
         SELECT l.tournament_id,
            sum((- l.amount)) AS prize_drawn,
            max(l.created_at) AS drawn_at
           FROM public.spin_reserve_ledger l
          WHERE ((l.kind = 'jackpot_draw'::text) AND (l.tournament_id IS NOT NULL))
          GROUP BY l.tournament_id
        ), paid AS (
         SELECT w.related_entity_id AS tournament_id,
            sum(w.amount) AS prize_credited
           FROM public.wallet_transactions w
          WHERE ((w.type = 'credit'::text) AND (w.category = 'prize'::text) AND (w.related_entity_id IS NOT NULL))
          GROUP BY w.related_entity_id
        )
 SELECT t.id AS tournament_id,
    t.club_id,
    t.name,
    t.buy_in_amount,
    t.spin_multiplier,
    t.started_at,
    t.ended_at,
    d.drawn_at,
    d.prize_drawn,
    p.prize_credited,
    round((p.prize_credited - d.prize_drawn), 2) AS draw_under_booked_by
   FROM ((draw d
     JOIN public.tournaments t ON (((t.id = d.tournament_id) AND (t.variant = 'spin'::text))))
     JOIN paid p ON ((p.tournament_id = d.tournament_id)))
  WHERE ((t.spin_multiplier IS NOT NULL) AND (p.prize_credited > d.prize_drawn) AND (p.prize_credited = round((t.buy_in_amount * t.spin_multiplier), 2)));

relations.name: v_spin_draw_distribution_7d
relations.view:
WITH drawn AS (
         SELECT (t.spin_multiplier)::integer AS multiplier
           FROM public.tournaments t
          WHERE ((t.variant = 'spin'::text) AND (t.spin_multiplier IS NOT NULL) AND (t.spin_multiplier > (0)::numeric) AND (t.created_at >= (now() - '7 days'::interval)))
        ), n AS (
         SELECT (count(*))::numeric AS draws
           FROM drawn
        ), denom AS (
         SELECT sum(spin_tier_spec.freq) AS f
           FROM public.spin_tier_spec
        )
 SELECT s.multiplier,
    COALESCE(a.actual, (0)::numeric) AS actual,
    round(((( SELECT n.draws
           FROM n) * (s.freq)::numeric) / ( SELECT denom.f
           FROM denom)), 2) AS expected,
    round((((100)::numeric * COALESCE(a.actual, (0)::numeric)) / NULLIF(( SELECT n.draws
           FROM n), (0)::numeric)), 4) AS actual_pct,
    round((((100 * s.freq))::numeric / ( SELECT denom.f
           FROM denom)), 4) AS spec_pct,
    (( SELECT n.draws
           FROM n))::bigint AS window_draws
   FROM (public.spin_tier_spec s
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT drawn.multiplier,
            (count(*))::numeric AS actual
           FROM drawn
          GROUP BY drawn.multiplier) a ON ((a.multiplier = s.multiplier)))
  ORDER BY s.multiplier;

relations.name: v_spin_draw_fairness
relations.view:
WITH spec AS (
         SELECT sum(spin_tier_spec.freq) AS total_freq,
            (sum(((spin_tier_spec.multiplier)::numeric * (spin_tier_spec.freq)::numeric)) / sum(spin_tier_spec.freq)) AS spec_e
           FROM public.spin_tier_spec
        ), spec_sd AS (
         SELECT s.spec_e,
            sqrt((sum(((t.freq)::numeric * power(((t.multiplier)::numeric - s.spec_e), (2)::numeric))) / s.total_freq)) AS spec_sd
           FROM (public.spin_tier_spec t
             CROSS JOIN spec s)
          GROUP BY s.spec_e, s.total_freq
        ), agg AS (
         SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE (tournaments.created_at >= (now() - '01:00:00'::interval))) AS d1,
            avg(tournaments.spin_multiplier) FILTER (WHERE (tournaments.created_at >= (now() - '01:00:00'::interval))) AS e1,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE ((tournaments.created_at >= (now() - '01:00:00'::interval)) AND (jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(tournaments.spin_locked_tiers, '[]'::jsonb)) > 0))) AS c1,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE (tournaments.created_at >= (now() - '24:00:00'::interval))) AS d24,
            avg(tournaments.spin_multiplier) FILTER (WHERE (tournaments.created_at >= (now() - '24:00:00'::interval))) AS e24,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE ((tournaments.created_at >= (now() - '24:00:00'::interval)) AND (jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(tournaments.spin_locked_tiers, '[]'::jsonb)) > 0))) AS c24,
            count(*) AS d7,
            avg(tournaments.spin_multiplier) AS e7,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE (jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(tournaments.spin_locked_tiers, '[]'::jsonb)) > 0)) AS c7
           FROM public.tournaments
          WHERE ((tournaments.variant = 'spin'::text) AND (tournaments.spin_multiplier IS NOT NULL) AND (tournaments.spin_multiplier > (0)::numeric) AND (tournaments.created_at >= (now() - '168:00:00'::interval)))
        ), shaped AS (
         SELECT '1h'::text AS window_label,
            1 AS window_hours,
            agg.d1 AS draws,
            agg.e1 AS realised_e,
            agg.c1 AS constrained_draws
           FROM agg
        UNION ALL
         SELECT '24h'::text,
            24,
            agg.d24,
            agg.e24,
            agg.c24
           FROM agg
        UNION ALL
         SELECT '7d'::text,
            168,
            agg.d7,
            agg.e7,
            agg.c7
           FROM agg
        )
 SELECT d.window_label,
    d.window_hours,
    d.draws,
    round(sd.spec_e, 6) AS spec_e,
    round(d.realised_e, 6) AS realised_e,
    round(sd.spec_sd, 6) AS spec_sd,
        CASE
            WHEN (d.draws >= 2) THEN round((sd.spec_sd / sqrt((d.draws)::numeric)), 6)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS sem,
        CASE
            WHEN ((d.draws >= 2) AND (sd.spec_sd > (0)::numeric)) THEN round(((d.realised_e - sd.spec_e) / (sd.spec_sd / sqrt((d.draws)::numeric))), 3)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS z,
    round(((100)::numeric * ((1)::numeric - (sd.spec_e / (3)::numeric))), 4) AS spec_edge_pct,
        CASE
            WHEN (d.draws > 0) THEN round(((100)::numeric * ((1)::numeric - (d.realised_e / (3)::numeric))), 4)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS realised_edge_pct,
    d.constrained_draws,
    ((d.draws >= 2000) AND (sd.spec_sd > (0)::numeric) AND (abs(((d.realised_e - sd.spec_e) / (sd.spec_sd / sqrt((d.draws)::numeric)))) >= (4)::numeric)) AS drift
   FROM (shaped d
     CROSS JOIN spec_sd sd)
  ORDER BY d.window_hours;

relations.name: v_spin_reserve_health
relations.view:
SELECT p.club_id,
    COALESCE(c.name, u.name) AS club_name,
    p.balance,
    p.seeded_amount,
    p.highest_stake,
    p.ceiling_amount,
    p.spin_count,
    p.total_deposited,
    p.total_drawn,
    round(((p.highest_stake * (100)::numeric) * 1.5), 2) AS need_for_100x,
    (p.balance >= ((p.highest_stake * (100)::numeric) * 1.5)) AS can_draw_100x,
    (p.balance < (p.highest_stake * (10)::numeric)) AS is_thin,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM public.spin_reserve_ledger l
          WHERE ((public.fn_spin_reserve_owner(l.club_id) = p.club_id) AND (l.kind = 'adjustment'::text) AND (l.note ~~* '%SHORTFALL%'::text) AND (l.created_at > (now() - '24:00:00'::interval)))) AS shortfall_events,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM public.tournaments t
          WHERE ((public.fn_spin_reserve_owner(t.club_id) = p.club_id) AND (t.variant = 'spin'::text) AND (t.status = ANY (ARRAY['RUNNING'::text, 'COMPLETED'::text])) AND (COALESCE(t.buy_in_fee, (0)::numeric) = (0)::numeric) AND (t.started_at > (now() - '24:00:00'::interval)) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM public.spin_reserve_ledger l2
                  WHERE (l2.tournament_id = t.id)))))) AS unbooked_24h,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM public.tournaments t
          WHERE ((public.fn_spin_reserve_owner(t.club_id) = p.club_id) AND (t.variant = 'spin'::text) AND (t.status = ANY (ARRAY['RUNNING'::text, 'COMPLETED'::text])) AND (COALESCE(t.spin_multiplier, (0)::numeric) <= (0)::numeric) AND (t.started_at > (now() - '24:00:00'::interval)))) AS null_multiplier_24h,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM public.tournaments t
          WHERE ((public.fn_spin_reserve_owner(t.club_id) = p.club_id) AND (t.variant = 'spin'::text) AND (t.status = ANY (ARRAY['RUNNING'::text, 'COMPLETED'::text])) AND (COALESCE(t.buy_in_fee, (0)::numeric) <> (0)::numeric) AND (t.started_at > (now() - '24:00:00'::interval)))) AS fee_violations_24h
   FROM ((public.spin_bonus_pools p
     LEFT JOIN public.clubs c ON ((c.id = p.club_id)))
     LEFT JOIN public.unions u ON ((u.id = p.club_id)));

relations.name: v_spin_reveal_latency
relations.view:
SELECT date_trunc('hour'::text, started_at) AS hour,
    count(*) AS spins,
    round((percentile_cont((0.5)::double precision) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ((spin_reveal_lag_ms)::double precision)))::numeric) AS p50_ms,
    round((percentile_cont((0.9)::double precision) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ((spin_reveal_lag_ms)::double precision)))::numeric) AS p90_ms,
    round((percentile_cont((0.99)::double precision) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ((spin_reveal_lag_ms)::double precision)))::numeric) AS p99_ms,
    max(spin_reveal_lag_ms) AS worst_ms,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (spin_reveal_lag_ms > 1000)) AS past_the_lead_in,
    (percentile_cont((0.5)::double precision) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ((spin_reveal_lag_ms)::double precision)) > (5000)::double precision) AS breach
   FROM public.tournaments t
  WHERE ((variant = 'spin'::text) AND (spin_reveal_lag_ms IS NOT NULL) AND (started_at > (now() - '7 days'::interval)))
  GROUP BY (date_trunc('hour'::text, started_at));

relations.name: v_spin_unfilled_waits
relations.view:
SELECT id AS tournament_id,
    club_id,
    name,
    buy_in_amount,
    max_players,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM (public.table_seats s
             JOIN public.tables tb ON ((tb.id = s.table_id)))
          WHERE ((tb.tournament_id = t.id) AND (s.left_at IS NULL))) AS live_seats,
    ( SELECT min(s.joined_at) AS min
           FROM (public.table_seats s
             JOIN public.tables tb ON ((tb.id = s.table_id)))
          WHERE ((tb.tournament_id = t.id) AND (s.left_at IS NULL))) AS oldest_seat_at,
    age(now(), ( SELECT min(s.joined_at) AS min
           FROM (public.table_seats s
             JOIN public.tables tb ON ((tb.id = s.table_id)))
          WHERE ((tb.tournament_id = t.id) AND (s.left_at IS NULL)))) AS longest_wait,
    round((buy_in_amount * (( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM (public.table_seats s
             JOIN public.tables tb ON ((tb.id = s.table_id)))
          WHERE ((tb.tournament_id = t.id) AND (s.left_at IS NULL))))::numeric), 2) AS chips_locked
   FROM public.tournaments t
  WHERE ((variant = 'spin'::text) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['REGISTERING'::text, 'ANNOUNCED'::text])) AND (started_at IS NULL) AND ((( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM (public.table_seats s
             JOIN public.tables tb ON ((tb.id = s.table_id)))
          WHERE ((tb.tournament_id = t.id) AND (s.left_at IS NULL))) >= 1) AND (( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM (public.table_seats s
             JOIN public.tables tb ON ((tb.id = s.table_id)))
          WHERE ((tb.tournament_id = t.id) AND (s.left_at IS NULL))) <= (COALESCE(max_players, 3) - 1))));

relations.name: v_spin_unpaid_settlements
relations.view:
WITH draw AS (
         SELECT l.tournament_id,
            sum((- l.amount)) AS prize_drawn,
            max(l.created_at) AS drawn_at
           FROM public.spin_reserve_ledger l
          WHERE ((l.kind = 'jackpot_draw'::text) AND (l.tournament_id IS NOT NULL))
          GROUP BY l.tournament_id
        ), returned AS (
         SELECT l.tournament_id,
            sum(l.amount) AS prize_returned
           FROM public.spin_reserve_ledger l
          WHERE ((l.kind = 'surplus_return'::text) AND (l.tournament_id IS NOT NULL))
          GROUP BY l.tournament_id
        ), paid AS (
         SELECT w.related_entity_id AS tournament_id,
            sum(w.amount) FILTER (WHERE (w.category = 'prize'::text)) AS prize_credited,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE (w.category = 'prize'::text)) AS credit_rows,
            sum(w.amount) FILTER (WHERE (w.category = 'refund'::text)) AS prize_refunded
           FROM public.wallet_transactions w
          WHERE ((w.type = 'credit'::text) AND (w.category = ANY (ARRAY['prize'::text, 'refund'::text])) AND (w.related_entity_id IS NOT NULL))
          GROUP BY w.related_entity_id
        ), seats AS (
         SELECT tp.tournament_id,
            count(*) AS seat_count,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE (tp."position" IS NULL)) AS unranked_seats,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE (tp.status = 'playing'::text)) AS still_playing_seats,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE (tp."position" = 1)) AS seats_at_first,
            COALESCE(sum(tp.prize), (0)::numeric) AS sum_seat_prize
           FROM public.tournament_players tp
          GROUP BY tp.tournament_id
        ), judged AS (
         SELECT d.tournament_id,
            d.prize_drawn,
            d.drawn_at,
            COALESCE(r.prize_returned, (0)::numeric) AS prize_returned,
            COALESCE(p.prize_credited, (0)::numeric) AS prize_credited,
            COALESCE(p.credit_rows, (0)::bigint) AS credit_rows,
            COALESCE(p.prize_refunded, (0)::numeric) AS prize_refunded,
            esc.prize_balance AS escrow_prize_balance,
                CASE
                    WHEN (esc.prize_balance IS NOT NULL) THEN round(LEAST(esc.prize_balance, (d.prize_drawn - COALESCE(r.prize_returned, (0)::numeric))), 2)
                    ELSE round((((d.prize_drawn - COALESCE(r.prize_returned, (0)::numeric)) - COALESCE(p.prize_credited, (0)::numeric)) - COALESCE(p.prize_refunded, (0)::numeric)), 2)
                END AS chips_short
           FROM (((draw d
             LEFT JOIN returned r ON ((r.tournament_id = d.tournament_id)))
             LEFT JOIN paid p ON ((p.tournament_id = d.tournament_id)))
             LEFT JOIN public.tournament_escrow esc ON ((esc.tournament_id = d.tournament_id)))
        )
 SELECT t.id AS tournament_id,
    t.club_id,
    t.name,
    t.status AS tournament_status,
    t.buy_in_amount,
    t.spin_multiplier,
    t.started_at,
    t.ended_at,
    j.drawn_at,
    j.prize_drawn,
    j.prize_credited,
    j.credit_rows,
    j.chips_short,
    COALESCE(s.seat_count, (0)::bigint) AS seat_count,
    COALESCE(s.unranked_seats, (0)::bigint) AS unranked_seats,
    COALESCE(s.still_playing_seats, (0)::bigint) AS still_playing_seats,
    COALESCE(s.seats_at_first, (0)::bigint) AS seats_at_first,
    COALESCE(s.sum_seat_prize, (0)::numeric) AS sum_seat_prize,
        CASE
            WHEN (j.prize_returned > (0)::numeric) THEN 'draw_returned'::text
            WHEN ((j.prize_credited = (0)::numeric) AND (j.prize_refunded = (0)::numeric)) THEN 'nobody_paid'::text
            WHEN (j.prize_credited < j.prize_drawn) THEN 'under_paid'::text
            ELSE 'over_paid'::text
        END AS verdict,
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(s.unranked_seats, (0)::bigint) > 0) THEN 'unranked_survivor'::text
            WHEN (COALESCE(s.seats_at_first, (0)::bigint) = 1) THEN 'ranked_but_unpaid'::text
            ELSE 'other'::text
        END AS seat_shape,
    j.prize_returned,
    j.prize_refunded,
    j.escrow_prize_balance
   FROM ((judged j
     JOIN public.tournaments t ON (((t.id = j.tournament_id) AND (t.variant = 'spin'::text))))
     LEFT JOIN seats s ON ((s.tournament_id = j.tournament_id)))
  WHERE ((j.chips_short <> (0)::numeric) AND (((t.status = ANY (ARRAY['COMPLETED'::text, 'CANCELLED'::text, 'CANCELED'::text])) AND (COALESCE(t.ended_at, j.drawn_at) < (now() - '00:10:00'::interval))) OR ((j.drawn_at < (now() - '02:00:00'::interval)) AND (t.status <> ALL (ARRAY['RUNNING'::text, 'REGISTERING'::text])))) AND (NOT ((j.prize_credited > j.prize_drawn) AND (t.spin_multiplier IS NOT NULL) AND (j.prize_credited = round((t.buy_in_amount * t.spin_multiplier), 2)))));

relations.name: v_system_health_cron
relations.view:
SELECT jobid,
    jobname,
    schedule,
    active,
    ( SELECT d.status
           FROM cron.job_run_details d
          WHERE (d.jobid = j.jobid)
          ORDER BY d.start_time DESC
         LIMIT 1) AS last_status,
    ( SELECT d.start_time
           FROM cron.job_run_details d
          WHERE (d.jobid = j.jobid)
          ORDER BY d.start_time DESC
         LIMIT 1) AS last_run_at,
    ( SELECT (d.end_time - d.start_time)
           FROM cron.job_run_details d
          WHERE (d.jobid = j.jobid)
          ORDER BY d.start_time DESC
         LIMIT 1) AS last_run_duration,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM cron.job_run_details d
          WHERE ((d.jobid = j.jobid) AND (d.start_time > (now() - '24:00:00'::interval)) AND (d.status = 'failed'::text))) AS failures_24h
   FROM cron.job j;

relations.name: v_tournament_rake_attribution_gaps
relations.view:
SELECT r.tournament_id,
    r.club_id,
    r.amount,
    r.source,
    r.settled_at,
    r.attributed_at,
    r.attributed_users,
    r.attribution_error,
    t.tournament_type,
    t.variant,
    t.name,
    t.buy_in_amount,
        CASE
            WHEN (r.attributed_users IS NULL) THEN 'never_measured'::text
            WHEN (r.attributed_users = '-1'::integer) THEN 'attribution_threw'::text
            WHEN (r.attributed_users = 0) THEN 'credited_nobody'::text
            ELSE 'ok'::text
        END AS verdict
   FROM (public.tournament_rake_settlements r
     LEFT JOIN public.tournaments t ON ((t.id = r.tournament_id)))
  WHERE ((r.settled_at IS NOT NULL) AND (r.amount > (0)::numeric) AND ((r.attributed_users IS NULL) OR (r.attributed_users <= 0)) AND (r.destination IS DISTINCT FROM 'diamond_house'::text));

relations.name: video_library_health
relations.view:
SELECT source_id,
    count(*) AS total_videos,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (duration IS NULL)) AS missing_duration,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE ((views_count = 0) OR (views_count IS NULL))) AS zero_views,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE ((published_at)::date = CURRENT_DATE)) AS fake_dates,
    max(scraped_at) AS last_scraped,
    min(published_at) AS oldest_video,
    max(published_at) AS newest_video
   FROM public.video_library_videos
  GROUP BY source_id
  ORDER BY (count(*)) DESC;

relations.name: video_library_public_catalog
relations.view:
SELECT youtube_video_id,
    source_id,
    source_name,
    type,
    title,
    thumbnail_url,
    views_text,
    views_count,
    duration,
    published_at,
    scraped_at,
    tags,
    availability_status,
    embeddable,
    availability_checked_at,
    attribution_name,
    attribution_url,
    disclosure_kind,
    sponsor_name,
    made_for_kids,
    moderation_state,
    takedown_case_id,
    taken_down_at
   FROM public.video_library_videos v
  WHERE ((moderation_state = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'restored'::text])) AND (taken_down_at IS NULL) AND public.fn_is_video_library_asset_eligible(id));

policies.name: authorized staff receive player history signals
policies.using:
((extension = 'broadcast'::text) AND (topic = realtime.topic()) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM ( SELECT
                CASE
                    WHEN (realtime.topic() ~ '^player-history:[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'::text) THEN (split_part(realtime.topic(), ':'::text, 2))::uuid
                    ELSE NULL::uuid
                END AS club_id) topic
  WHERE public.ca_player_history_can_read(topic.club_id))))

policies.name: authorized viewers receive club roster changes
authorized viewers receive member record changes
club members receive roster wallet signals
policies.using:
((extension = 'broadcast'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM ( SELECT
                CASE
                    WHEN (realtime.topic() ~ '^club-roster-wallet:[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'::text) THEN (split_part(realtime.topic(), ':'::text, 2))::uuid
                    ELSE NULL::uuid
                END AS club_id) topic
  WHERE ((topic.club_id IS NOT NULL) AND (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid) IS NOT NULL) AND ((EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM public.club_members m
          WHERE ((m.club_id = topic.club_id) AND (m.user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (COALESCE(m.status, 'approved'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'approved'::text]))))) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM public.profiles p
          WHERE ((p.id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND p.is_admin))) OR public.fn_union_oversees_club(topic.club_id, ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)))))))

policies.name: players receive their own account change signal
policies.using: ((extension = 'broadcast'::text) AND (( SELECT realtime.topic() AS topic) = ('profile-account:'::text || (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))::text)))

policies.name: players receive their own appearance signal
policies.using: ((extension = 'broadcast'::text) AND (( SELECT realtime.topic() AS topic) = ('profile-appearance:'::text || (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))::text)))

policies.name: readable tables receive appearance signals
policies.using:
((extension = 'broadcast'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM public.tables t
  WHERE (t.id = ( SELECT
                CASE
                    WHEN (realtime.topic() ~ '^table-appearance:[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'::text) THEN (split_part(realtime.topic(), ':'::text, 2))::uuid
                    ELSE NULL::uuid
                END AS "case")))))

policies.name: users receive own daily mission completion broadcasts
policies.using: ((extension = 'broadcast'::text) AND (( SELECT realtime.topic() AS topic) = ('daily-mission-completion:'::text || (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))::text)))

policies.name: users receive own daily mission revision broadcasts
policies.using: ((extension = 'broadcast'::text) AND (( SELECT realtime.topic() AS topic) = ('daily-mission-revision:'::text || (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))::text)))

relations.name: sp_real_humans
relations.view:
SELECT p.id,
    p.created_at,
    p.last_seen,
    p.phone_verified,
    p.is_vip,
    p.vip_tier,
    p.vip_expires_at,
    p.referred_by,
    p.username,
    u.email_confirmed_at
   FROM (public.profiles p
     JOIN auth.users u ON ((u.id = p.id)))
  WHERE ((NOT COALESCE(p.is_horse, false)) AND (NOT COALESCE(u.is_anonymous, false)) AND ((p.id)::text !~~ '00000000-0000-0000-0000-%'::text) AND (POSITION(('@'::text) IN (COALESCE(u.email, ''::character varying))) > 0) AND (lower((u.email)::text) !~ '(\.invalid|\.local|\.test|@horses\.smarter\.poker|@hydra\.bot|@example\.(com|org|net))$'::text) AND (lower((u.email)::text) !~ '@([a-z0-9-]+\.)*(smarter\.poker|pepnationlab\.com|bekavactrading\.com)$'::text) AND (lower(COALESCE(p.email, ''::text)) !~ '(\.invalid|\.local|\.test|@hydra\.bot|@example\.(com|org|net))$'::text) AND (COALESCE(p.username, ''::text) !~* '^(deleted-|crest_cert_|postdeploy|reels_qa|trivia_canary|codex-)'::text) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM public.ca_cert_accounts c
          WHERE ((c.user_id = p.id) AND c.active)))));

constraints.name: buckets_lifecycle_configuration_shape_check
constraints.definition:
CHECK (((lifecycle_configuration IS NULL) OR ((jsonb_typeof(lifecycle_configuration) = 'object'::text) AND (lifecycle_configuration ? 'rules'::text) AND
CASE
    WHEN (jsonb_typeof((lifecycle_configuration -> 'rules'::text)) = 'array'::text) THEN ((jsonb_array_length((lifecycle_configuration -> 'rules'::text)) >= 1) AND (jsonb_array_length((lifecycle_configuration -> 'rules'::text)) <= 1000))
    ELSE false
END)))

constraints.name: buckets_lifecycle_configuration_standard_only_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((type = 'STANDARD'::storage.buckettype) OR ((lifecycle_configuration IS NULL) AND (lifecycle_configuration_generation IS NULL))))

Authenticated users can upload messenger media
Users can delete their own messenger media
ad creatives sponsor owner insert
policies.check:
((bucket_id = 'ad-creatives'::text) AND ((storage.foldername(name))[1] = 'sponsor'::text) AND ((storage.foldername(name))[2] ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM public.ad_advertiser a
  WHERE ((a.id = ((storage.foldername(a.name))[2])::uuid) AND (a.kind = 'sponsor'::text) AND a.self_serve AND (a.owner_user_id = auth.uid()) AND (a.status = 'active'::text)))))
